MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.full_note: Literature Review Of Multi-Agent Debate For Problem-Solving 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Communication_Topology 👤 作者： Arne Tillmann 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-05-29 13:57:00 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.00066v1 🧾 一句话总结： 从智能体画像、通信结构和决策过程维度系统梳理了多智能体大模型辩论研究的现状与挑战，为构建高效多智能体AI提供了参考路线图。 📄 摘要： Multi-agent large language models (MA-LLMs) are a rapidly growing research area that leverages multiple interacting language agents to tackle complex tasks, outperforming single-agent large language models. This literature review synthesizes the latest research on agent profiles, communication structures, and decision-making processes, drawing insights from both traditional multi-agent systems and state-of-the-art MA-LLM studies. In doing so, it aims to address the lack of direct comparisons in the field, illustrating how factors like scalability, communication structure, and decision-making processes influence MA-LLM performance. By examining frequent practices and outlining current challenges, the review reveals that multi-agent approaches can yield superior results but also face elevated computational costs and under-explored challenges unique to MA-LLM. Overall, these findings provide researchers and practitioners with a roadmap for developing robust and efficient multi-agent AI solutions. 🧠 核心术语库 [[MA-LLMs]] [[Agent profiles]] [[Communication structures]] [[Decision-making processes]] [[Scalability]] [[Computational costs]] 🔬 核心方法简述 文献综述法。综合传统多智能体系统与前沿MA-LLM研究，从智能体画像、通信结构和决策过程三个核心维度对多智能体辩论机制进行系统梳理与横向对比。 💬 锐评 该综述切入点（画像、通信、决策）切中MA-LLM领域要害，试图填补横向比较的空白。但摘要暴露出的核心结论（多智能体性能提升伴随高计算成本）仅为领域内常识。若全文未能深入剖析具体通信拓扑（如环形、星型、全连接）在辩论机制下的定量差异及其对涌现行为的影响，则其价值可能仅停留在文献罗列层面，难以真正指导底层架构创新。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.title: Red-Teaming LLM Multi-Agent Systems via Communication Attacks
MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.short_review: 该研究视角敏锐，首次系统性揭露了多智能体系统的‘通信信道’这一盲点漏洞，证明了无需攻破智能体本体即可瘫痪系统的‘降维打击’可能性。然而，其攻击前提假设对通信链路具有控制权（类似网络层的中间人攻击），在封闭或加密的多智能体架构中实施难度较大，更偏向于系统架构级风险而非模型内生缺陷。
MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.full_note: Red-Teaming LLM Multi-Agent Systems via Communication Attacks 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Communication_Topology 👤 作者： Pengfei He, Yupin Lin, Shen Dong, Han Xu, Yue Xing, Hui Liu 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-02-20 18:55:39 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.14847v2 🧾 一句话总结： 开创性地指出了多智能体系统的通信链路是比单点智能体更致命的‘阿喀琉斯之踵’，是系统鲁棒性研究的必看之作。 📄 摘要： Large Language Model-based Multi-Agent Systems (LLM-MAS) have revolutionized complex problem-solving capability by enabling sophisticated agent collaboration through message-based communications. While the communication framework is crucial for agent coordination, it also introduces a critical yet unexplored security vulnerability. In this work, we introduce Agent-in-the-Middle (AiTM), a novel attack that exploits the fundamental communication mechanisms in LLM-MAS by intercepting and manipulating inter-agent messages. Unlike existing attacks that compromise individual agents, AiTM demonstrates how an adversary can compromise entire multi-agent systems by only manipulating the messages passing between agents. To enable the attack under the challenges of limited control and role-restricted communication format, we develop an LLM-powered adversarial agent with a reflection mechanism that generates contextually-aware malicious instructions. Our comprehensive evaluation across various frameworks, communication structures, and real-world applications demonstrates that LLM-MAS is vulnerable to communication-based attacks, highlighting the need for robust security measures in multi-agent systems. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Agent-in-the-Middle (AiTM)]] [[LLM-MAS Communication Vulnerability]] [[Inter-agent Message Manipulation]] [[Adversarial Reflection Mechanism]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出Agent-in-the-Middle (AiTM)攻击范式，区别于攻击单智能体，该方法通过拦截并篡改智能体间的通信消息实施攻击；为此设计了具备反思机制的对抗性智能体，以生成符合上下文语境的恶意指令，突破有限控制和格式受限的挑战。 💬 锐评 该研究视角敏锐，首次系统性揭露了多智能体系统的‘通信信道’这一盲点漏洞，证明了无需攻破智能体本体即可瘫痪系统的‘降维打击’可能性。然而，其攻击前提假设对通信链路具有控制权（类似网络层的中间人攻击），在封闭或加密的多智能体架构中实施难度较大，更偏向于系统架构级风险而非模型内生缺陷。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.title: Beyond Self-Talk: A Communication-Centric Survey of LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.short_review: 在现有研究大多沉迷于给智能体分配特定角色或堆叠应用场景时，这篇论文精准切中了多智能体系统的命门——即智能体之间如何高效且安全地“对话”。它试图打破“黑盒”交互，解构通信拓扑与协议，这为解决当前LLM-MAS中普遍存在的低效“自言自语”和缺乏标准化基准的问题提供了关键的理论透镜，但需警惕其提出的分类框架是否能真正指导工程实践，而不仅仅是学术上的标签化。
MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.full_note: Beyond Self-Talk: A Communication-Centric Survey of LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Communication_Topology 👤 作者： Bingyu Yan, Zhibo Zhou, Litian Zhang, Lian Zhang, Ziyi Zhou, Dezhuang Miao, Zhoujun Li, Chaozhuo Li, Xiaoming Zhang 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-02-20 07:18:34 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.14321v3 🧾 一句话总结： 本文首次从通信视角系统性综述了LLM多智能体系统，构建了涵盖架构、协议、策略等维度的分析框架，揭示了通信效率、安全及可扩展性等核心挑战，为设计鲁棒的协同智能系统提供了理论基础。 📄 摘要： Large language model-based multi-agent systems have recently gained significant attention due to their potential for complex, collaborative, and intelligent problem-solving capabilities. Existing surveys typically categorize LLM-based multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) according to their application domains or architectures, overlooking the central role of communication in coordinating agent behaviors and interactions. To address this gap, this paper presents a comprehensive survey of LLM-MAS from a communication-centric perspective. Specifically, we propose a structured framework that integrates system-level communication (architecture, goals, and protocols) with system internal communication (strategies, paradigms, objects, and content), enabling a detailed exploration of how agents interact, negotiate, and achieve collective intelligence. Through an extensive analysis of recent literature, we identify key components in multiple dimensions and summarize their strengths and limitations. In addition, we highlight current challenges, including communication efficiency, security vulnerabilities, inadequate benchmarking, and scalability issues, and outline promising future research directions. This review aims to help researchers and practitioners gain a clear understanding of the communication mechanisms in LLM-MAS, thereby facilitating the design and deployment of robust, scalable, and secure multi-agent systems. 🧠 核心术语库 [[LLM-MAS (基于大语言模型的多智能体系统)]] [[以通信为中心]] [[系统级通信]] [[系统内部通信]] [[集体智能]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出了一种双层结构化框架，将系统级通信（架构、目标、协议）与系统内部通信（策略、范式、对象、内容）相结合，对LLM-MAS的通信机制进行系统性文献综述与维度解构。 💬 锐评 在现有研究大多沉迷于给智能体分配特定角色或堆叠应用场景时，这篇论文精准切中了多智能体系统的命门——即智能体之间如何高效且安全地“对话”。它试图打破“黑盒”交互，解构通信拓扑与协议，这为解决当前LLM-MAS中普遍存在的低效“自言自语”和缺乏标准化基准的问题提供了关键的理论透镜，但需警惕其提出的分类框架是否能真正指导工程实践，而不仅仅是学术上的标签化。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.title: Cut the Crap: An Economical Communication Pipeline for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.short_review: 这篇论文切中了LLM多智能体系统大规模部署的痛点——高昂的通信成本。通过证明简洁的修剪机制不仅能减少70%以上的Token，还能提升安全性，它挑战了复杂拓扑的必要性，是迈向实用化的重要一步。
MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.full_note: Cut the Crap: An Economical Communication Pipeline for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Communication_Topology 👤 作者： Guibin Zhang, Yanwei Yue, Zhixun Li, Sukwon Yun, Guancheng Wan, Kun Wang, Dawei Cheng, Jeffrey Xu Yu, Tianlong Chen 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2024-10-03 14:14:31 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.02506v1 🧾 一句话总结： AgentPrune 通过在时空消息传递图上识别并修剪冗余/恶意消息，在显著降低成本和提升安全性的同时，实现了高性能的 LLM 多智能体通信。 📄 摘要： Recent advancements in large language model (LLM)-powered agents have shown that collective intelligence can significantly outperform individual capabilities, largely attributed to the meticulously designed inter-agent communication topologies. Though impressive in performance, existing multi-agent pipelines inherently introduce substantial token overhead, as well as increased economic costs, which pose challenges for their large-scale deployments. In response to this challenge, we propose an economical, simple, and robust multi-agent communication framework, termed $\texttt{AgentPrune}$, which can seamlessly integrate into mainstream multi-agent systems and prunes redundant or even malicious communication messages. Technically, $\texttt{AgentPrune}$ is the first to identify and formally define the \textit{communication redundancy} issue present in current LLM-based multi-agent pipelines, and efficiently performs one-shot pruning on the spatial-temporal message-passing graph, yielding a token-economic and high-performing communication topology. Extensive experiments across six benchmarks demonstrate that $\texttt{AgentPrune}$ \textbf{(I)} achieves comparable results as state-of-the-art topologies at merely $\$5.6$ cost compared to their $\$43.7$, \textbf{(II)} integrates seamlessly into existing multi-agent frameworks with $28.1\%\sim72.8\%\downarrow$ token reduction, and \textbf{(III)} successfully defend against two types of agent-based adversarial attacks with $3.5\%\sim10.8\%\uparrow$ performance boost. 🧠 核心术语库 [[AgentPrune]] [[Communication Redundancy]] [[Spatial-temporal message-passing graph]] [[Token Economic]] [[Adversarial Defense]] 🔬 核心方法简述 AgentPrune 通过形式化定义通信冗余问题，在时空消息传递图上执行一次性修剪，剔除冗余或恶意消息，从而构建出高性价比的通信拓扑。 💬 锐评 这篇论文切中了LLM多智能体系统大规模部署的痛点——高昂的通信成本。通过证明简洁的修剪机制不仅能减少70%以上的Token，还能提升安全性，它挑战了复杂拓扑的必要性，是迈向实用化的重要一步。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.title: Exploring Large Language Model based Intelligent Agents: Definitions, Methods, and Prospects
MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.short_review: 批判性锐评：论文虽全面概述了LLM智能代理的研究现状，但缺乏对具体技术细节的深入分析，且未充分探讨潜在的理论局限性和未来研究方向。此外，多智能体系统中的通信策略部分略显笼统，未结合具体案例进行深入探讨。
MultiAgent_Communication_Topology.full_note: Exploring Large Language Model based Intelligent Agents: Definitions, Methods, and Prospects 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Communication_Topology 👤 作者： Yuheng Cheng, Ceyao Zhang, Zhengwen Zhang, Xiangrui Meng, Sirui Hong, Wenhao Li, Zihao Wang, Zekai Wang, Feng Yin, Junhua Zhao, Xiuqiang He 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2024-01-07 09:08:24 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.03428v1 🧾 一句话总结： 一句话价值总结：本文系统性地介绍了基于LLM的智能代理在单一和多智能体系统中的应用，为该领域的研究提供了全面的框架和方向。 📄 摘要： Intelligent agents stand out as a potential path toward artificial general intelligence (AGI). Thus, researchers have dedicated significant effort to diverse implementations for them. Benefiting from recent progress in large language models (LLMs), LLM-based agents that use universal natural language as an interface exhibit robust generalization capabilities across various applications -- from serving as autonomous general-purpose task assistants to applications in coding, social, and economic domains, LLM-based agents offer extensive exploration opportunities. This paper surveys current research to provide an in-depth overview of LLM-based intelligent agents within single-agent and multi-agent systems. It covers their definitions, research frameworks, and foundational components such as their composition, cognitive and planning methods, tool utilization, and responses to environmental feedback. We also delve into the mechanisms of deploying LLM-based agents in multi-agent systems, including multi-role collaboration, message passing, and strategies to alleviate communication issues between agents. The discussions also shed light on popular datasets and application scenarios. We conclude by envisioning prospects for LLM-based agents, considering the evolving landscape of AI and natural language processing. 🧠 核心术语库 [[LLM-based intelligent agents]] [[single-agent and multi-agent systems]] [[cognitive and planning methods]] [[tool utilization]] [[multi-role collaboration]] [[message passing]] [[communication strategies]] 🔬 核心方法简述 核心方法简述：基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能代理定义、研究框架及多智能体系统中的部署机制，涵盖单一智能体和多智能体系统中的认知、规划、工具利用和通信策略。 💬 锐评 批判性锐评：论文虽全面概述了LLM智能代理的研究现状，但缺乏对具体技术细节的深入分析，且未充分探讨潜在的理论局限性和未来研究方向。此外，多智能体系统中的通信策略部分略显笼统，未结合具体案例进行深入探讨。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Organization_Coordination.title: Cooperative Profiles Predict Multi-Agent LLM Team Performance in AI for Science Workflows
MultiAgent_Organization_Coordination.short_review: 该研究创新性打通了抽象博弈行为与现实多智能体科学协作表现的预测链路，提出的低成本诊断框架实用性极强；但仅覆盖6类博弈、3类科学任务场景，合作画像的跨领域泛化性尚未得到充分验证，且未揭示不同博弈表现对应具体协作策略的映射机制，框架可解释性仍有提升空间
MultiAgent_Organization_Coordination.full_note: Cooperative Profiles Predict Multi-Agent LLM Team Performance in AI for Science Workflows 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Organization_Coordination 👤 作者： Shivani Kumar, Adarsh Bharathwaj, David Jurgens 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-04-22 15:07:54 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.20658v1 🧾 一句话总结： 本研究证实LLM的行为经济学博弈合作画像可独立预测其所在多智能体团队在AI for科学任务中的协作表现，为多智能体系统部署前提供了高效低成本的分流诊断工具 📄 摘要： Multi-agent systems built from teams of large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for collaborative scientific reasoning and problem-solving. These systems require agents to coordinate under shared constraints, such as GPUs or credit balances, where cooperative behavior matters. Behavioral economics provides a rich toolkit of games that isolate distinct cooperation mechanisms, yet it remains unknown whether a model's behavior in these stylized settings predicts its performance in realistic collaborative tasks. Here, we benchmark 35 open-weight LLMs across six behavioral economics games and show that game-derived cooperative profiles robustly predict downstream performance in AI-for-Science tasks, where teams of LLM agents collaboratively analyze data, build models, and produce scientific reports under shared budget constraints. Models that effectively coordinate games and invest in multiplicative team production (rather than greedy strategies) produce better scientific reports across three outcomes, accuracy, quality, and completion. These associations hold after controlling for multiple factors, indicating that cooperative disposition is a distinct, measurable property of LLMs not reducible to general ability. Our behavioral games framework thus offers a fast and inexpensive diagnostic for screening cooperative fitness before costly multi-agent deployment. 🧠 核心术语库 [[多智能体LLM系统]] [[行为经济学博弈]] [[合作画像]] [[乘性团队生产]] [[AI for科学工作流]] 🔬 核心方法简述 对35款开源权重LLM开展6项行为经济学博弈基准测试，提取合作画像，验证其能否预测多智能体LLM团队在共享预算约束下完成AI for科学任务（数据分析、建模、生成科研报告）的表现（准确性、质量、完成度），控制多变量后确认合作特质是独立于通用能力的可测量属性 💬 锐评 该研究创新性打通了抽象博弈行为与现实多智能体科学协作表现的预测链路，提出的低成本诊断框架实用性极强；但仅覆盖6类博弈、3类科学任务场景，合作画像的跨领域泛化性尚未得到充分验证，且未揭示不同博弈表现对应具体协作策略的映射机制，框架可解释性仍有提升空间 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Organization_Coordination.title: Reinforcement Learning-Augmented LLM Agents for Collaborative Decision Making and Performance Optimization
MultiAgent_Organization_Coordination.short_review: 将经典MARL框架与前沿GRPO算法结合应用于LLM Agent的思路顺理成章，联合奖励的设计直击多智能体协作中速度与成本的痛点。但在冷启动视角下，CTDE在LLM语境下获取全局信息的成本不容忽视，且需警惕其在更复杂、非确定状态空间任务中的泛化能力。
MultiAgent_Organization_Coordination.full_note: Reinforcement Learning-Augmented LLM Agents for Collaborative Decision Making and Performance Optimization 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Organization_Coordination 👤 作者： Dong Qiu, Duo Xu, Limengxi Yue 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-12-31 03:59:18 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.24609v1 🧾 一句话总结： 该论文通过引入Dec-POMDP、CTDE与GRPO算法，为LLM多智能体协作提供了具有可观性能提升（3倍速、高一致性）的实用强化学习优化路径。 📄 摘要： Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well in language tasks but often lack collaborative awareness and struggle to optimize global performance in multi-agent settings. We present a reinforcement learning-augmented LLM agent framework that formulates cooperation as a decentralized partially observable Markov decision process (Dec-POMDP) and adopts centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE). We introduce Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to jointly optimize agent policies with access to global signals during training, together with a simplified joint reward that balances task quality, speed, and coordination cost. On collaborative writing and coding benchmarks, our framework delivers a 3x increase in task processing speed over single-agent baselines, 98.7% structural/style consistency in writing, and a 74.6% test pass rate in coding. MultiAgent_Organization_Coordination.title: Shapley-Coop: Credit Assignment for Emergent Cooperation in Self-Interested LLM Agents
MultiAgent_Organization_Coordination.short_review: 该论文敏锐地捕捉到了LLM多智能体系统从‘预设流程’向‘开放协作’演进的关键痛点——利益分配。引入Shapley值作为定价锚点极具理论美感，试图用经济学逻辑替代单纯的提示词工程。然而，其‘Shapley思维链’本质上是对计算复杂度的妥协近似，在长链条或复杂任务中，LLM能否精准估算边际贡献而非‘拍脑袋’定价是其实际落地能力的最大隐患。
MultiAgent_Organization_Coordination.full_note: Shapley-Coop: Credit Assignment for Emergent Cooperation in Self-Interested LLM Agents 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Organization_Coordination 👤 作者： Yun Hua, Haosheng Chen, Shiqin Wang, Wenhao Li, Xiangfeng Wang, Jun Luo 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-06-09 03:24:01 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.07388v1 🧾 一句话总结： 开创性地将博弈论贡献分配机制引入LLM多智能体协作，利用经济学手段有效解决了开放环境下自利智能体的激励对齐难题。 📄 摘要： Large Language Models (LLMs) show strong collaborative performance in multi-agent systems with predefined roles and workflows. However, in open-ended environments lacking coordination rules, agents tend to act in self-interested ways. The central challenge in achieving coordination lies in credit assignment -- fairly evaluating each agent's contribution and designing pricing mechanisms that align their heterogeneous goals. This problem is critical as LLMs increasingly participate in complex human-AI collaborations, where fair compensation and accountability rely on effective pricing mechanisms. Inspired by how human societies address similar coordination challenges (e.g., through temporary collaborations such as employment or subcontracting), we propose a cooperative workflow, Shapley-Coop. Shapley-Coop integrates Shapley Chain-of-Thought -- leveraging marginal contributions as a principled basis for pricing -- with structured negotiation protocols for effective price matching, enabling LLM agents to coordinate through rational task-time pricing and post-task reward redistribution. This approach aligns agent incentives, fosters cooperation, and maintains autonomy. We evaluate Shapley-Coop across two multi-agent games and a software engineering simulation, demonstrating that it consistently enhances LLM agent collaboration and facilitates equitable credit assignment. These results highlight the effectiveness of Shapley-Coop's pricing mechanisms in accurately reflecting individual contributions during task execution. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Credit Assignment]] [[Shapley Value]] [[Marginal Contribution]] [[Incentive Alignment]] [[Negotiation Protocols]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出Shapley-Coop框架，核心结合Shapley思维链与结构化谈判协议，通过量化边际贡献实现任务时的理性定价与任务后的公平奖励再分配，从而解决自利LLM智能体的激励对齐问题。 💬 锐评 该论文敏锐地捕捉到了LLM多智能体系统从‘预设流程’向‘开放协作’演进的关键痛点——利益分配。引入Shapley值作为定价锚点极具理论美感，试图用经济学逻辑替代单纯的提示词工程。然而，其‘Shapley思维链’本质上是对计算复杂度的妥协近似，在长链条或复杂任务中，LLM能否精准估算边际贡献而非‘拍脑袋’定价是其实际落地能力的最大隐患。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

MultiAgent_Organization_Coordination.title: Towards Collaborative Intelligence: Propagating Intentions and Reasoning for Multi-Agent Coordination with Large Language Models
MultiAgent_Organization_Coordination.short_review: 该研究切中多智能体协作中意图对齐这一核心痛点，利用LLM的高层语义理解能力，通过引入传播网络实现精准的'点对点'通信而非盲目广播，架构设计具有显著创新性。然而，摘要中对于LLM的具体训练范式（微调还是上下文学习）表述模糊，且周期性广播在复杂高频交互场景下可能面临通信开销与信息过载的挑战，其宣称的'减少误协调'高度依赖于落地模块在语义与环境状态对齐上的鲁棒性。
MultiAgent_Organization_Coordination.full_note: Towards Collaborative Intelligence: Propagating Intentions and Reasoning for Multi-Agent Coordination with Large Language Models 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： MultiAgent_Organization_Coordination 👤 作者： Xihe Qiu, Haoyu Wang, Xiaoyu Tan, Chao Qu, Yujie Xiong, Yuan Cheng, Yinghui Xu, Wei Chu, Yuan Qi 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2024-07-17 13:14:00 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.12532v1 🧾 一句话总结： 提出基于LLM的意图传播与三模块协作框架，通过显式化私有意图及动态重规划机制，有效解决了多智能体强化学习中的通信瓶颈与任务协调难题。 📄 摘要： Effective collaboration in multi-agent systems requires communicating goals and intentions between agents. Current agent frameworks often suffer from dependencies on single-agent execution and lack robust inter-module communication, frequently leading to suboptimal multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) policies and inadequate task coordination. To address these challenges, we present a framework for training large language models (LLMs) as collaborative agents to enable coordinated behaviors in cooperative MARL. Each agent maintains a private intention consisting of its current goal and associated sub-tasks. Agents broadcast their intentions periodically, allowing other agents to infer coordination tasks. A propagation network transforms broadcast intentions into teammate-specific communication messages, sharing relevant goals with designated teammates. The architecture of our framework is structured into planning, grounding, and execution modules. During execution, multiple agents interact in a downstream environment and communicate intentions to enable coordinated behaviors. The grounding module dynamically adapts comprehension strategies based on emerging coordination patterns, while feedback from execution agents influnces the planning module, enabling the dynamic re-planning of sub-tasks. Results in collaborative environment simulation demonstrate intention propagation reduces miscoordination errors by aligning sub-task dependencies between agents. Agents learn when to communicate intentions and which teammates require task details, resulting in emergent coordinated behaviors. This demonstrates the efficacy of intention sharing for cooperative multi-agent RL based on LLMs. 🧠 核心术语库 [[意图传播]] [[传播网络]] [[私有意图]] [[协作式多智能体强化学习]] [[落地模块]] [[动态重新规划]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的三模块（规划、落地、执行）协作智能体框架。智能体维护包含目标与子任务的私有意图，通过周期性广播共享意图，并利用传播网络将广播内容转化为针对特定队友的定制化消息，同时执行反馈会触发规划模块的动态重规划。 💬 锐评 该研究切中多智能体协作中意图对齐这一核心痛点，利用LLM的高层语义理解能力，通过引入传播网络实现精准的'点对点'通信而非盲目广播，架构设计具有显著创新性。然而，摘要中对于LLM的具体训练范式（微调还是上下文学习）表述模糊，且周期性广播在复杂高频交互场景下可能面临通信开销与信息过载的挑战，其宣称的'减少误协调'高度依赖于落地模块在语义与环境状态对齐上的鲁棒性。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Multi_LLM_Agent_General.title: When Does Personality Composition Matter for Multi-Agent LLM Teams?
Multi_LLM_Agent_General.short_review: 这篇论文提供了至关重要的“现实核查”，打破了“性格提示=合作=更好”的直觉假设。它揭示性格效应具有极强的任务依赖性：在结构化任务中效果微弱，但在非结构化的协作和议价任务中却会严重拖累性能。这为多智能体系统的性格工程设计指明了方向，即性格操纵不能盲目通用化，必须与任务场景深度耦合。
Multi_LLM_Agent_General.full_note: When Does Personality Composition Matter for Multi-Agent LLM Teams? 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Multi_LLM_Agent_General 👤 作者： Aryan Keluskar, Amrita Bhattacharjee, Huan Liu 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-06-25 18:13:33 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.27443v2 🧾 一句话总结： 性格提示对多智能体团队性能的影响高度依赖于任务结构，在结构化任务中影响微小，而在开放式协作与议价任务中则显著降低表现。 📄 摘要： Personality prompting shapes how large language models communicate, yet whether these behavioral shifts affect objective task outcomes remains under-explored. Prior work shows that agents prompted with low agreeableness produce adversarial language, while those prompted with high agreeableness become cooperative, but the relationship between communication style and task performance has not been systematically examined across multiple domains. In this work, we investigate whether personality composition matters for multi-agent team performance by manipulating personality traits across frontier LLMs on three task domains: structured coding, open-ended research collaboration, and competitive bargaining. We find that personality effects depend critically on task structure. In coding tasks, low agreeableness leads to large communication shifts that have little effect on milestone completion. In open-ended collaboration and bargaining, the same manipulation substantially degrades performance. Multi_LLM_Agent_General.short_review: 批判性锐评：该方法的创新性在于其自改进机制和无需标注的验证记忆库，显著降低了诊断成本。然而，框架的性能高度依赖于症状的明确性和工具化执行的可信度，对于复杂或模糊的错误场景可能效果有限。此外，多智能体团队的协作效率和任务分配机制未在论文中详细阐述，可能影响实际应用中的鲁棒性。
Multi_LLM_Agent_General.full_note: Towards Self-Improving Error Diagnosis in Multi-Agent Systems 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Multi_LLM_Agent_General 👤 作者： Jiazheng Li, Emine Yilmaz, Bei Chen, Dieu-Thu Le 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-04-19 23:13:05 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17658v1 🧾 一句话总结： ErrorProbe 通过自改进和无需标注的验证记忆库，实现了对多智能体系统错误的精准定位和跨域迁移，为 LLM-based MAS 的调试提供了高效解决方案。 📄 摘要： Large Language Model (LLM)-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) enable complex problem-solving but introduce significant debugging challenges, characterized by long interaction traces, inter-agent dependencies, and delayed error manifestation. Existing diagnostic approaches often rely on expensive expert annotation or ''LLM-as-a-judge'' paradigms, which struggle to pinpoint decisive error steps within extended contexts. In this paper, we introduce ErrorProbe, a self-improving framework for semantic failure attribution that identifies responsible agents and the originating error step. The framework operates via a three-stage pipeline: (1) operationalizing the MAS failure taxonomy to detect local anomalies, (2) performing symptom-driven backward tracing to prune irrelevant context, and (3) employing a specialized multi-agent team (Strategist, Investigator, Arbiter) to validate error hypotheses through tool-grounded execution. Crucially, ErrorProbe maintains a verified episodic memory that updates only when error patterns are confirmed by executable evidence, without the need for annotation. Experiments across the TracerTraj and Who&When benchmarks demonstrate that ErrorProbe significantly outperforms baselines, particularly in step-level localization, while the verified memory enables robust cross-domain transfer without retraining. 🧠 核心术语库 [[多智能体系统（MAS）]] [[语义失败归因]] [[ErrorProbe 框架]] [[症状驱动的反向追踪]] [[经过验证的事件记忆库]] 🔬 核心方法简述 核心方法简述：ErrorProbe 是一个自改进的框架，通过三阶段流程诊断多智能体系统（MAS）中的错误。第一阶段，将 MAS 失败分类操作化以检测局部异常；第二阶段，执行症状驱动的反向追踪以修剪不相关的上下文；第三阶段，使用专门的多智能体团队（策略师、调查员、仲裁员）通过工具化执行验证错误假设。该框架通过维护一个经过验证的事件记忆库来更新错误模式，无需人工标注。 💬 锐评 批判性锐评：该方法的创新性在于其自改进机制和无需标注的验证记忆库，显著降低了诊断成本。然而，框架的性能高度依赖于症状的明确性和工具化执行的可信度，对于复杂或模糊的错误场景可能效果有限。此外，多智能体团队的协作效率和任务分配机制未在论文中详细阐述，可能影响实际应用中的鲁棒性。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

A Controlled Study of Multi-Agent Debate in Logical Reasoning 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： Multi_LLM_Agent_General 👤 作者： Haolun Wu, Zhenkun Li, Lingyao Li 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-11-11 03:05:47 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.07784v1 🧾 一句话总结： 本研究通过控制实验验证多智能体辩论的逻辑推理效果由智能体自身推理能力与群体多样性主导，揭示多数派压力抑制独立纠错等关键行为规律，为可解释、求真向的多智能体推理系统设计提供实证依据 📄 摘要： Multi-agent debate (MAD) has recently emerged as a promising framework for improving the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs). Yet, whether LLM agents can genuinely engage in deliberative reasoning, beyond simple ensembling or majority voting, remains unclear. We address this question through a controlled study using the Knight--Knave--Spy logic puzzle, which enables precise, step-wise evaluation of debate outcomes and processes under verifiable ground truth. We systematically set up six structural and cognitive factors, including agent team size, composition, confidence visibility, debate order, debate depth, and task difficulty, to disentangle their respective effects on collective reasoning. Our results show that intrinsic reasoning strength and group diversity are the dominant drivers of debate success, while structural parameters such as order or confidence visibility offer limited gains. Beyond outcomes, process-level analyses identify key behavioral patterns: majority pressure suppresses independent correction, effective teams overturn incorrect consensus, and rational, validity-aligned reasoning most strongly predicts improvement. These findings provide valuable insights into how and why LLM debates succeed or fail, offering guidance for designing interpretable and truth-seeking multi-agent reasoning systems. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Multi-Agent Debate (MAD)]] [[Knight-Knave-Spy逻辑谜题]] [[群体多样性]] [[多数派压力]] [[置信度可见性]] 🔬 核心方法简述 选用可验证ground truth的骑士-无赖-间谍（Knight-Knave-Spy）逻辑谜题作为研究基准，系统设置团队规模、成员组成、置信度可见性、辩论顺序、辩论深度、任务难度6类结构/认知控制变量开展对照实验，结合辩论结果与过程行为分析，拆解各因素对多智能体辩论逻辑推理效果的影响机制 💬 锐评 研究仅局限于特定结构的逻辑谜题场景，结论向开放域推理等复杂场景的泛化性存疑；仅控制了6类预设变量，未覆盖现实多智能体交互中的动态噪声变量；仅揭示了辩论效果的核心影响因素，未提出针对性结构优化方案，落地指导性有限 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Multi_LLM_Agent_General.short_review: 该工作通过只训练一个Leader来协调团队，理论上确实降低了训练成本，但存在几个潜在问题：(1) Leader能力成为系统瓶颈，其推理质量直接决定整体表现；(2) 论文未清晰阐述如何选择合适的Base Model作为Leader；(3) 在BBH、MATH、MMLU上的提升幅度和一致性需要更详细的消融实验支撑；(4) 推理时仍需调用多个模型，计算成本优势可能并不明显。整体思路有一定创新性，但具体实现细节和有效性验证略显不足。
Multi_LLM_Agent_General.full_note: How to Train a Leader: Hierarchical Reasoning in Multi-Agent LLMs 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： Multi_LLM_Agent_General 👤 作者： Andrew Estornell, Jean-Francois Ton, Muhammad Faaiz Taufiq, Hang Li 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-07-11 18:34:07 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.08960v1 🧾 一句话总结： 提出仅训练单一Leader LLM协调多智能体团队的框架MLPO，在降低训练成本的同时通过层次化推理提升复杂任务性能，为多智能体LLM系统的高效协作提供了新思路。 📄 摘要： Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance on a wide range of complex reasoning tasks, yet further gains are often possible by leveraging the complementary strengths of multiple models. While multi-agent frameworks can improve solution quality by leveraging multiple LLMs, existing methods are often computationally expensive, both at training and inference time. In this work, we introduce a hierarchical multi-agent framework that addresses these challenges by training only a single leader LLM to coordinate a team of untrained peer agents. To this end, we propose Multi-agent guided Leader Policy \textbf{O}ptimization (MLPO), a novel approach which trains the leader to evaluate and synthesize agent responses without auxiliary value networks or explicit agent feedback. Leaders trained with MLPO exhibit improved performance not only when interacting with the agent team at inference time, but also enjoy improved performance when deployed in single-agent settings without the team. Empirical results on Big-Bench Hard (BBH), MATH, and MMLU demonstrate that our framework achieves substantial performance improvements over both single-agent and multi-agent baselines. Our results highlight the effectiveness and efficiency of training a single, flexible leader for collaborative reasoning in multi-agent LLM systems. 🧠 核心术语库 [[层次化多智能体推理]] [[Leader Policy Optimization (MLPO)]] [[Peer Agents（未经训练的协作智能体）]] [[多智能体协作推理]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出层次化多智能体框架，仅训练一个Leader LLM来协调未经训练的Peer Agents。核心方法MLPO（Multi-agent guided Leader Policy Optimization）训练Leader评估和综合智能体响应，无需辅助价值网络或显式反馈 。Leader训练后既可用于多智能体协作场景，也可单独部署提升单智能体性能。 💬 锐评 该工作通过只训练一个Leader来协调团队，理论上确实降低了训练成本，但存在几个潜在问题：(1) Leader能力成为系统瓶颈，其推理质量直接决定整体表现；(2) 论文未清晰阐述如何选择合适的Base Model作为Leader；(3) 在BBH、MATH、MMLU上的提升幅度和一致性需要更详细的消融实验支撑；(4) 推理时仍需调用多个模型，计算成本优势可能并不明显。整体思路有一定创新性，但具体实现细节和有效性验证略显不足。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Multi_LLM_Agent_General.title: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems via Textual Backpropagation
Multi_LLM_Agent_General.short_review: 将多智能体系统强映射为分层神经网络（节点与层）并提供'文本反向传播'机制，概念包装极具吸引力。但神经网络的梯度反向传播具备严密的数学可微性基础，而文本层面的'反向传播'本质上更可能是基于LLM反思能力的提示词优化与结构调整，缺乏数学上的收敛性保证。此外，动态构建多层团队配合迭代反馈必然带来极高的Token消耗与延迟，其在实际工程中的性价比以及'自演化'过程的稳定性仍需存疑。
Multi_LLM_Agent_General.full_note: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems via Textual Backpropagation 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： Multi_LLM_Agent_General 👤 作者： Xiaowen Ma, Yunpu Ma, Chenyang Lin, Sikuan Yan, Jinhe Bi, Zixuan Cao, Yijun Tian, Volker Tresp, Hinrich Schuetze 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-06-10 17:59:21 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.09046v3 🧾 一句话总结： 通过引入类神经网络的前向任务分解与反向文本反馈机制，赋予多智能体系统自我演化角色与协作策略的能力，突破了传统静态框架的局限。 📄 摘要： Leveraging multiple Large Language Models (LLMs) has proven effective for addressing complex, high-dimensional tasks, but current approaches often rely on static, manually engineered multi-agent configurations. To overcome these constraints, we present the Agentic Neural Network (ANN), a framework that conceptualizes multi-agent collaboration as a layered neural network architecture. In this design, each agent operates as a node, and each layer forms a cooperative team focused on a specific subtask. Our framework follows a two-phase optimization strategy: (1) Forward Phase - Drawing inspiration from neural network forward passes, tasks are dynamically decomposed into subtasks, and cooperative agent teams with suitable aggregation methods are constructed layer by layer. (2) Backward Phase - Mirroring backpropagation, we refine both global and local collaboration through iterative feedback, allowing agents to self-evolve their roles, prompts, and coordination. This neuro-symbolic approach enables our framework to create new or specialized agent teams post-training, delivering notable gains in accuracy and adaptability. Across seven benchmark datasets, our work surpasses leading multi-agent baselines under the same configurations, showing consistent performance improvements. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Agentic Neural Network (ANN)]] [[Textual Backpropagation]] [[Forward Phase]] [[Backward Phase]] [[Self-evolving Multi-Agent Systems]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出Agentic Neural Network (ANN)框架，将多智能体协作建模为分层神经网络。前向阶段动态分解任务并逐层构建具有聚合方法的智能体团队；反向阶段通过文本反向传播机制提供迭代反馈，驱动智能体自演化其角色、提示词和协作策略，实现系统的自我优化。 💬 锐评 将多智能体系统强映射为分层神经网络（节点与层）并提供'文本反向传播'机制，概念包装极具吸引力。但神经网络的梯度反向传播具备严密的数学可微性基础，而文本层面的'反向传播'本质上更可能是基于LLM反思能力的提示词优化与结构调整，缺乏数学上的收敛性保证。此外，动态构建多层团队配合迭代反馈必然带来极高的Token消耗与延迟，其在实际工程中的性价比以及'自演化'过程的稳定性仍需存疑。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Multi_LLM_Agent_General.title: ACC-Collab: An Actor-Critic Approach to Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration
Multi_LLM_Agent_General.short_review: 该文直击当前多智能体LLM研究痛点——过度依赖基座模型的“涌现”能力而缺乏显式优化。将协作视为可训练的技能是方法论上的重要纠偏。但局限在于将复杂的群体协作简化为“生成-评判”二元结构，可能限制了更复杂拓扑结构的潜力；此外，RLHF在多智能体场景下的训练稳定性与算力成本是实际落地的核心挑战。

Recent works have demonstrated that the efficacy of such models can be improved through iterative dialog between multiple models. While these paradigms show promise in improving model efficacy, most works in this area treat collaboration as an emergent behavior, rather than a learned behavior. In doing so, current multi-agent frameworks rely on collaborative behaviors to have been sufficiently trained into off-the-shelf models. Multi_LLM_Agent_General.short_review: 论文选题切中LLM智能体研究的热点——即从单体能力向群体协作与环境交互的跃迁。但摘要披露的实验场景（室友、编程）略显常规，容易让人联想到《Generative Agents》或简单的DevGpts变体。其核心价值取决于是否真正定义和量化了“协同效应”，还是仅仅展示了多智能体在共享环境下的并发操作。若无更深层的机制分析，该框架可能仅停留在工程演示层面。

Multi_LLM_Agent_General.short_review: 作为冷启动阶段的奠基之作，本文精准地指出了从单智能体RL向多智能体系统扩展的痛点（如协调与通信缺失）。虽然侧重于综述而非具体算法实现，但它为理解LLM在复杂交互环境中的应用提供了关键的分类框架和未来路线图，极具战略指导意义。

To inspire more research on LLM-based MARL, in this letter, we survey the existing LLM-based single-agent and multi-agent RL frameworks and provide potential research directions for future research. Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy.full_note: HIPIF: Hierarchical Planning and Information Folding for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Learning 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy 👤 作者： Juncheng Diao, Zhicong Lu, Peiguang Li, Yongwei Zhou, Changyuan Tian, Qingbin Li, Rongxiang Weng, Jingang Wang, Xunliang Cai 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-06-09 07:35:14 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10507v1 🧾 一句话总结： HIPIF通过分层规划和信息折叠有效解决了长时程LLM智能体的长上下文干扰问题，提升了其任务执行能力。 📄 摘要： While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities as autonomous agents across a wide range of tasks, their performance often degrades in multi-turn long-horizon agentic tasks. Existing methods have made progress through fine-grained credit assignment to alleviate long-horizon sparse rewards and hierarchical reinforcement learning to decompose tasks and reduce long-term dependency. However, these methods still do not directly address long-context interference, in which continuously growing histories weaken the agent's ability to track the global task state and impair subsequent reasoning and decision-making. Inspired by the way humans handle complex tasks through subgoal decomposition and completed progress summarization, we propose Hierarchical Planning and Information Folding (HIPIF) for long-horizon LLM agent learning. HIPIF trains the agent end-to-end to organize long-horizon execution around explicit subgoals while folding completed subgoal histories to reduce long-context interference. Furthermore, to stabilize subgoal-based planning and execution, HIPIF combines hierarchical reflection and subgoal-oriented process rewards to guide subgoal generation, transition, and execution, without relying on costly auxiliary models or task-specific expert trajectories. Extensive experiments on three publicly available agentic benchmarks demonstrate the validity of our method. 🧠 核心术语库 [[分层规划]] [[信息折叠]] [[长时程LLM智能体]] [[子目标分解]] [[长上下文干扰]] 🔬 核心方法简述 核心方法简述：HIPIF通过分层规划和信息折叠来训练长时程LLM智能体。它通过将长时程任务分解为明确的子目标，并对已完成的子目标历史进行折叠以减少长上下文干扰，从而提升智能体的推理和决策能力。此外，HIPIF结合分层反思和子目标导向的过程奖励来稳定子目标的生成、转换和执行。 💬 锐评 批判性锐评：HIPIF提出的信息折叠机制新颖，但未详细说明折叠的具体实现方式及其对模型性能的影响。此外，分层反思和过程奖励的设计可能需要大量调参，且其泛化能力有待进一步验证。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy.full_note: MAGE: Safeguarding LLM Agents against Long-Horizon Threats via Shadow Memory 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy 👤 作者： Yuhui Wang, Tanqiu Jiang, Jiacheng Liang, Charles Fleming, Ting Wang 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-05-04 23:46:19 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.03228v1 🧾 一句话总结： MAGE是首个通过专用安全智能体内存实现LLM智能体长程威胁检测与缓解的防御框架，为LLM智能体的安全部署提供了新的研究范式 📄 摘要： As large language model (LLM)-powered agents are increasingly deployed to perform complex, real-world tasks, they face a growing class of attacks that exploit extended user-agent-environment interactions to pursue malicious objectives improbable in single-turn settings. Such long-horizon threats pose significant risks to the safe deployment of LLM agents in critical domains. In this paper, we present MAGE (Memory As Guardrail Enforcement), a novel defensive framework designed to counter a wide range of long-horizon threats. Inspired by the "shadow stack" abstraction in systems security, MAGE maintains a dedicated, safety-focused agentic memory that distills and retains safety-critical context across the agent's full execution trajectory, leveraging this shadow memory to proactively assess the risk of pending actions prior to their execution. Extensive evaluation demonstrates that MAGE substantially outperforms existing defenses across diverse long-horizon threats in detection accuracy, achieves early-stage detection for the majority of attacks, and introduces only negligible overhead to agent utility. To our best knowledge, MAGE represents the first framework to detect and mitigate long-horizon threats using an agentic memory approach, establishing a new paradigm for this critical challenge and opening promising directions for future research. 🧠 核心术语库 [[MAGE (Memory As Guardrail Enforcement)]] [[影子内存（Shadow Memory）]] [[长程威胁（Long-Horizon Threats）]] [[影子栈（shadow stack）]] [[智能体内存（agentic memory）]] 🔬 核心方法简述 借鉴系统安全领域的影子栈抽象，构建独立的安全导向智能体内存，在LLM智能体全执行轨迹中提炼留存安全关键上下文，于待执行动作落地前利用该内存提前评估风险，实现长程威胁的检测与缓解 💬 锐评 作为领域首个同类框架，未公开威胁缓解的具体实现细节；仅提及引入的额外开销可忽略，但未给出不同场景、不同规模智能体下的量化开销对比；未讨论框架对非长程类型攻击的泛化能力 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy.title: The Long-Horizon Task Mirage? Diagnosing Where and Why Agentic Systems Break
Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy.short_review: 研究聚焦长周期任务失效现象，但未深入探讨底层认知机制；基准测试依赖特定模型族可能限制普适性；人类标注验证虽有效，但存在主观性偏差风险
Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy.full_note: The Long-Horizon Task Mirage? Diagnosing Where and Why Agentic Systems Break 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy 👤 作者： Xinyu Jessica Wang, Haoyue Bai, Yiyou Sun, Haorui Wang, Shuibai Zhang, Wenjie Hu, Mya Schroder, Bilge Mutlu, Dawn Song, Robert D Nowak 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-04-13 19:11:42 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11978v1 🧾 一句话总结： 系统性揭示长周期代理失效模式，为构建可靠长周期智能体提供方法论框架和实践指导 📄 摘要： Large language model (LLM) agents perform strongly on short- and mid-horizon tasks, but often break down on long-horizon tasks that require extended, interdependent action sequences. Despite rapid progress in agentic systems, these long-horizon failures remain poorly characterized, hindering principled diagnosis and comparison across domains. To address this gap, we introduce HORIZON, an initial cross-domain diagnostic benchmark for systematically constructing tasks and analyzing long-horizon failure behaviors in LLM-based agents. Using HORIZON, we evaluate state-of-the-art (SOTA) agents from multiple model families (GPT-5 variants and Claude models), collecting 3100+ trajectories across four representative agentic domains to study horizon-dependent degradation patterns. We further propose a trajectory-grounded LLM-as-a-Judge pipeline for scalable and reproducible failure attribution, and validate it with human annotation on trajectories, achieving strong agreement (inter-annotator κ=0.61; human-judge κ=0.84). Our findings offer an initial methodological step toward systematic, cross-domain analysis of long-horizon agent failures and offer practical guidance for building more reliable long-horizon agents. We release our project website at \href{https://xwang2775.github.io/horizon-leaderboard/}{HORIZON Leaderboard} and welcome contributions from the community. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Long-Horizon Task]] [[Agentic System Failure]] [[Trajectory-Grounded Analysis]] [[Cross-Domain Benchmarking]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出HORIZON跨域诊断基准，通过系统构造任务和分析长周期失败行为；采用轨迹基础的LLM-as-a-Judge流程进行可扩展失败归因，结合人类标注验证 💬 锐评 研究聚焦长周期任务失效现象，但未深入探讨底层认知机制；基准测试依赖特定模型族可能限制普适性；人类标注验证虽有效，但存在主观性偏差风险 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy.title: AgentSwing: Adaptive Parallel Context Management Routing for Long-Horizon Web Agents
Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy.short_review: 该工作精准打击了现有静态上下文管理策略在长时程任务中'一步错步步错'或'信息过载'的痛点。将上下文管理从单一的工程技巧提升为可建模的决策过程，其提出的概率框架具有很好的理论启发性。虽然并行分支扩展看似增加了计算成本，但换取了交互轮次3倍的缩减和性能上限的突破，体现了'以计算换决策质量'的明智权衡，是长时程智能体语境管理方向的重要进展。
Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy.full_note: AgentSwing: Adaptive Parallel Context Management Routing for Long-Horizon Web Agents 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy 👤 作者： Zhaopeng Feng, Liangcai Su, Zhen Zhang, Xinyu Wang, Xiaotian Zhang, Xiaobin Wang, Runnan Fang, Qi Zhang, Baixuan Li, Shihao Cai, Rui Ye, Hui Chen, Jiang Yong, Joey Tianyi Zhou, Chenxiong Qian, Pengjun Xie, Bryan Hooi, Zuozhu Liu, Jingren Zhou 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-03-29 02:59:27 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.27490v1 🧾 一句话总结： 针对长时程智能体上下文僵化瓶颈，提出基于概率框架的自适应并行路由方法，显著提升效率与性能上限。 📄 摘要： As large language models (LLMs) evolve into autonomous agents for long-horizon information-seeking, managing finite context capacity has become a critical bottleneck. Existing context management methods typically commit to a single fixed strategy throughout the entire trajectory. Such static designs may work well in some states, but they cannot adapt as the usefulness and reliability of the accumulated context evolve during long-horizon search. To formalize this challenge, we introduce a probabilistic framework that characterizes long-horizon success through two complementary dimensions: search efficiency and terminal precision. Building on this perspective, we propose AgentSwing, a state-aware adaptive parallel context management routing framework. At each trigger point, AgentSwing expands multiple context-managed branches in parallel and uses lookahead routing to select the most promising continuation. Experiments across diverse benchmarks and agent backbones show that AgentSwing consistently outperforms strong static context management methods, often matching or exceeding their performance with up to $3\times$ fewer interaction turns while also improving the ultimate performance ceiling of long-horizon web agents. Beyond the empirical gains, the proposed probabilistic framework provides a principled lens for analyzing and designing future context management strategies for long-horizon agents. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Long-Horizon Web Agents]] [[Adaptive Context Management]] [[Lookahead Routing]] [[Probabilistic Framework]] [[Parallel Branch Expansion]] 🔬 核心方法简述 引入概率框架（涵盖搜索效率与终端精度）形式化长时程成功，提出AgentSwing框架：一种状态感知的自适应并行上下文管理路由机制，在触发点并行展开多个上下文管理分支，利用前瞻路由选择最优路径。 💬 锐评 该工作精准打击了现有静态上下文管理策略在长时程任务中'一步错步步错'或'信息过载'的痛点。将上下文管理从单一的工程技巧提升为可建模的决策过程，其提出的概率框架具有很好的理论启发性。虽然并行分支扩展看似增加了计算成本，但换取了交互轮次3倍的缩减和性能上限的突破，体现了'以计算换决策质量'的明智权衡，是长时程智能体语境管理方向的重要进展。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy.title: Can LLM Agents Be CFOs? Benchmarking Long-Horizon Resource Allocation in an Uncertain Enterprise Environment
Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy.short_review: 这项研究无情地揭露了LLM Agent在现实决策中的软肋：仅有15.4%的存活率且大模型无显著优势，说明当前Agent框架根本无法处理延迟反馈与硬约束并存的复杂局面，将研究视角从简单的任务执行拉回到了更为核心的生存与规划难题。
Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy.full_note: Can LLM Agents Be CFOs? Benchmarking Long-Horizon Resource Allocation in an Uncertain Enterprise Environment 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy 👤 作者： Yi Han, Yan Wang, Lingfei Qian, Haohang Li, Yupeng Cao, Yueru He, Xueqing Peng, Nanhan Shen, Yitao Xu, Yankai Chen, Dongji Feng, Jimin Huang, Xue Liu, Jian-Yun Nie, Sophia Ananiadou 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-03-24 18:25:00 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.23638v2 🧾 一句话总结： 通过构建高保真的企业金融模拟器，该论文揭示了LLM Agent在长视野、不确定性及硬约束环境下的资源分配能力存在显著缺口。 📄 摘要： Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly tested on complex tasks, but their ability to allocate scarce resources over long horizons remains unclear. Unlike reactive tasks with immediate feedback, this setting requires agents to make binding commitments under partial observability, delayed consequences, hard resource budgets, and shifting dynamics. We introduce EnterpriseArena, a 132-month CFO simulator that evaluates long-horizon resource allocation under uncertainty in a FinTech lending firm. Agents must manage liquidity, close books, gather costly signals, and request equity or debt financing across changing macroeconomic regimes. The simulator is built from transformed firm-level financial data, anonymized business documents, decade-scale macroeconomic and industry signals, and expert-validated operating rules. Experiments across 23 LLMs and four agent frameworks show that current agents remain far from robust: only 15.4% of trials survive the full horizon, larger models do not reliably outperform smaller ones, and failures cascade across observation, action timing, and capital sizing. These findings establish long-horizon resource allocation under uncertainty as a distinct capability gap for LLM agents. 🧠 核心术语库 [[EnterpriseArena]] [[Long-Horizon Resource Allocation]] [[Partial Observability]] [[Binding Commitments]] [[Capital Sizing]] 🔬 核心方法简述 构建了名为EnterpriseArena的132个月CFO模拟器，整合真实金融数据、匿名化文档及十年尺度宏观信号，在FinTech借贷场景下对23个LLM和4种Agent框架进行长视野资源分配能力的基准测试。 💬 锐评 这项研究无情地揭露了LLM Agent在现实决策中的软肋：仅有15.4%的存活率且大模型无显著优势，说明当前Agent框架根本无法处理延迟反馈与硬约束并存的复杂局面，将研究视角从简单的任务执行拉回到了更为核心的生存与规划难题。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy.title: AgentLAB: Benchmarking LLM Agents against Long-Horizon Attacks
Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy.short_review: 在冷启动阶段，该工作精准切中LLM agent安全的核心痛点：从静态的单轮Prompt注入转向动态的长周期交互风险。AgentLAB不仅定义了攻击类型，更重要的是揭示了多轮交互中“累积效应”带来的独特安全挑战，为后续安全研究提供了明确的“试金石”和标准化的攻击范式。
Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy.full_note: AgentLAB: Benchmarking LLM Agents against Long-Horizon Attacks 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy 👤 作者： Tanqiu Jiang, Yuhui Wang, Jiacheng Liang, Ting Wang 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-02-18 21:30:20 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.16901v1 🧾 一句话总结： AgentLAB是首个专门针对LLM agent长周期交互安全挑战的基准测试，通过五种新型攻击类型验证了现有防御在多轮交互中的失效，为Agent安全研究提供了关键评估标准。 📄 摘要： LLM agents are increasingly deployed in long-horizon, complex environments to solve challenging problems, but this expansion exposes them to long-horizon attacks that exploit multi-turn user-agent-environment interactions to achieve objectives infeasible in single-turn settings. To measure agent vulnerabilities to such risks, we present AgentLAB, the first benchmark dedicated to evaluating LLM agent susceptibility to adaptive, long-horizon attacks. Currently, AgentLAB supports five novel attack types including intent hijacking, tool chaining, task injection, objective drifting, and memory poisoning, spanning 28 realistic agentic environments, and 644 security test cases. Leveraging AgentLAB, we evaluate representative LLM agents and find that they remain highly susceptible to long-horizon attacks; moreover, defenses designed for single-turn interactions fail to reliably mitigate long-horizon threats. We anticipate that AgentLAB will serve as a valuable benchmark for tracking progress on securing LLM agents in practical settings. The benchmark is publicly available at https://tanqiujiang.github.io/AgentLAB_main. 🧠 核心术语库 [[长周期攻击]] [[AgentLAB]] [[意图劫持]] [[工具链]] [[任务注入]] [[目标漂移]] [[记忆投毒]] [[自适应攻击]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出首个专门针对LLM agent长周期攻击的基准测试AgentLAB。通过定义意图劫持、工具链、任务注入、目标漂移、记忆投毒五种新型攻击类型，覆盖28个现实环境及644个测试用例，评估了代表性模型在多轮交互中的脆弱性，并验证了现有单轮防御在长周期威胁下的失效。 💬 锐评 在冷启动阶段，该工作精准切中LLM agent安全的核心痛点：从静态的单轮Prompt注入转向动态的长周期交互风险。AgentLAB不仅定义了攻击类型，更重要的是揭示了多轮交互中“累积效应”带来的独特安全挑战，为后续安全研究提供了明确的“试金石”和标准化的攻击范式。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy.full_note: Choosing How to Remember: Adaptive Memory Structures for LLM Agents 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy 👤 作者： Mingfei Lu, Mengjia Wu, Feng Liu, Jiawei Xu, Weikai Li, Haoyang Wang, Zhengdong Hu, Ying Ding, Yizhou Sun, Jie Lu, Yi Zhang 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-02-15 07:56:24 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.14038v1 🧾 一句话总结： 该论文通过自适应记忆结构和多结构融合，显著提升了LLM代理在长时程交互中的表现，为长时程自主代理的记忆管理提供了新的思路和方法。 📄 摘要： Memory is critical for enabling large language model (LLM) based agents to maintain coherent behavior over long-horizon interactions. However, existing agent memory systems suffer from two key gaps: they rely on a one-size-fits-all memory structure and do not model memory structure selection as a context-adaptive decision, limiting their ability to handle heterogeneous interaction patterns and resulting in suboptimal performance. We propose a unified framework, FluxMem, that enables adaptive memory organization for LLM agents. Our framework equips agents with multiple complementary memory structures. It explicitly learns to select among these structures based on interaction-level features, using offline supervision derived from downstream response quality and memory utilization. To support robust long-horizon memory evolution, we further introduce a three-level memory hierarchy and a Beta Mixture Model-based probabilistic gate for distribution-aware memory fusion, replacing brittle similarity thresholds. Experiments on two long-horizon benchmarks, PERSONAMEM and LoCoMo, demonstrate that our method achieves average improvements of 9.18% and 6.14%. 🧠 核心术语库 [[自适应记忆结构]] [[多记忆结构融合]] [[基于交互特征的记忆选择]] [[三层记忆层次]] [[Beta Mixture Model概率门]] 🔬 核心方法简述 核心方法简述：提出FluxMem框架，为LLM代理提供多互补记忆结构，并显式学习根据交互级特征选择结构，引入三层记忆层次和基于Beta Mixture Model的概率门进行分布感知记忆融合。 💬 锐评 批判性锐评：框架依赖于离线监督进行记忆选择，可能不适用于动态变化的交互环境；三层记忆层次的具体实现细节和计算复杂度未详细说明，可能影响实际部署效率。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy.full_note: Scaling Long-Horizon LLM Agent via Context-Folding 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy 👤 作者： Weiwei Sun, Miao Lu, Zhan Ling, Kang Liu, Xuesong Yao, Yiming Yang, Jiecao Chen 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-10-13 22:00:58 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.11967v1 🧾 一句话总结： 通过动态上下文折叠与强化学习结合，实现长周期任务中高效推理与性能突破 📄 摘要： Large language model (LLM) agents are fundamentally constrained by context length on long-horizon tasks. We introduce Context-Folding, a framework that empowers agents to actively manage their working context. An agent can procedurally branch into a sub-trajectory to handle a subtask and then fold it upon completion, collapsing the intermediate steps while retaining a concise summary of the outcome. To make this behavior learnable, we develop an end-to-end reinforcement learning framework FoldGRPO with specific process rewards to encourage effective task decomposition and context management. On complex long-horizon tasks (Deep Research and SWE), our folding agent matches or outperforms the ReAct baselines while using an active context 10$\times$ smaller and significantly outperforms models that rely on summarization-based context management. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Context-Folding]] [[Sub-trajectory]] [[FoldGRPO]] [[Process Rewards]] [[Long-Horizon Tasks]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出Context-Folding框架，通过子轨迹分支处理子任务并折叠中间步骤，结合FoldGRPO强化学习框架与过程奖励机制实现长周期任务的上下文管理优化 💬 锐评 方法在特定任务场景展现优势，但未明确验证跨领域泛化能力；过程奖励设计可能引入偏差风险；折叠机制对上下文压缩边界条件的鲁棒性需进一步检验 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy.title: OdysseyBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Complex Office Application Workflows
Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy.short_review: 该工作填补了LLM智能体评估从原子任务到真实复杂场景的空白，HomerAgents的自动化生成框架具有可扩展性优势；但基准测试本质上是评估工具而非方法论突破，其挑战性程度取决于任务设计的覆盖广度；真实场景（OdysseyBench+）与合成场景（Odyssey-Neo）的分布差异可能影响泛化评估的可靠性；此外600余任务规模相对有限，对于全面评估长时序推理能力可能还需扩充
Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy.full_note: OdysseyBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Complex Office Application Workflows 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy 👤 作者： Weixuan Wang, Dongge Han, Daniel Madrigal Diaz, Jin Xu, Victor Rühle, Saravan Rajmohan 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-08-12 17:53:03 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.09124v1 🧾 一句话总结： OdysseyBench是首个针对LLM智能体在长时序跨办公应用工作流上评估的综合基准，配合HomerAgents自动化生成框架，为真实复杂场景下的智能体能力评估提供了新范式 📄 摘要： Autonomous agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications requiring complex, long-horizon workflows. However, existing benchmarks predominantly focus on atomic tasks that are self-contained and independent, failing to capture the long-term contextual dependencies and multi-interaction coordination required in realistic scenarios. To address this gap, we introduce OdysseyBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on long-horizon workflows across diverse office applications including Word, Excel, PDF, Email, and Calendar. Our benchmark comprises two complementary splits: OdysseyBench+ with 300 tasks derived from real-world use cases, and OdysseyBench-Neo with 302 newly synthesized complex tasks. Each task requires agent to identify essential information from long-horizon interaction histories and perform multi-step reasoning across various applications. To enable scalable benchmark creation, we propose HomerAgents, a multi-agent framework that automates the generation of long-horizon workflow benchmarks through systematic environment exploration, task generation, and dialogue synthesis. Our extensive evaluation demonstrates that OdysseyBench effectively challenges state-of-the-art LLM agents, providing more accurate assessment of their capabilities in complex, real-world contexts compared to existing atomic task benchmarks. We believe that OdysseyBench will serve as a valuable resource for advancing the development and evaluation of LLM agents in real-world productivity scenarios. In addition, we release OdysseyBench and HomerAgents to foster research along this line. 🧠 核心术语库 [[长时序工作流（Long-Horizon Workflows）]] [[原子任务基准（Atomic Task Benchmarks）]] [[多智能体框架（Multi-Agent Framework）]] [[上下文依赖（Contextual Dependencies）]] [[多应用协调（Multi-Application Coordination）]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出 OdysseyBench基准测试，包含OdysseyBench+（300个真实任务）和OdysseyBench-Neo（302个合成任务），覆盖Word、Excel、PDF、Email、Calendar等办公应用；设计HomerAgents多智能体框架，通过系统化环境探索、任务生成和对话合成自动化构建长时序工作流基准；每个任务要求智能体从长时序交互历史中识别关键信息并执行跨应用多步推理 💬 锐评 该工作填补了LLM智能体评估从原子任务到真实复杂场景的空白，HomerAgents的自动化生成框架具有可扩展性优势；但基准测试本质上是评估工具而非方法论突破，其挑战性程度取决于任务设计的覆盖广度；真实场景（OdysseyBench+）与合成场景（Odyssey-Neo）的分布差异可能影响泛化评估的可靠性；此外600余任务规模相对有限，对于全面评估长时序推理能力可能还需扩充 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy.title: Robotouille: An Asynchronous Planning Benchmark for LLM Agents
Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy.short_review: 精准击中了当前LLM智能体在处理时序依赖和并行任务时的软肋——GPT-4o在异步任务上11%的惨淡成功率极具警醒意义。然而，仅用现有ReAct框架作为试金石略显单薄，真正缺乏的是针对异步时序推理机制本身的创新，而非仅仅造一个更难的关卡来证明现有方法不行。
Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy.full_note: Robotouille: An Asynchronous Planning Benchmark for LLM Agents 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： Agent_Long_Horizon_Autonomy 👤 作者： Gonzalo Gonzalez-Pumariega, Leong Su Yean, Neha Sunkara, Sanjiban Choudhury 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-02-06 05:50:37 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.05227v1 🧾 一句话总结： 提出Robotouille基准，暴露出LLM智能体在长程异步规划（处理并行、重叠及中断任务）上的严重短板，指明了未来长程自治研究的关键改进方向。 📄 摘要： Effective asynchronous planning, or the ability to efficiently reason and plan over states and actions that must happen in parallel or sequentially, is essential for agents that must account for time delays, reason over diverse long-horizon tasks, and collaborate with other agents. While large language model (LLM) agents show promise in high-level task planning, current benchmarks focus primarily on short-horizon tasks and do not evaluate such asynchronous planning capabilities. We introduce Robotouille, a challenging benchmark environment designed to test LLM agents' ability to handle long-horizon asynchronous scenarios. Our synchronous and asynchronous datasets capture increasingly complex planning challenges that go beyond existing benchmarks, requiring agents to manage overlapping tasks and interruptions. Our results show that ReAct (gpt4-o) achieves 47% on synchronous tasks but only 11% on asynchronous tasks, highlighting significant room for improvement. We further analyze failure modes, demonstrating the need for LLM agents to better incorporate long-horizon feedback and self-audit their reasoning during task execution. Code is available at https://github.com/portal-cornell/robotouille. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Asynchronous planning]] [[Long-horizon tasks]] [[Overlapping tasks]] [[ReAct]] [[Self-audit]] 🔬 核心方法简述 构建了Robotouille基准环境，包含同步与异步数据集，通过要求智能体管理重叠任务和中断来评估LLM在长程异步场景下的规划能力，并对ReAct等方法的失败模式进行了深入分析。 💬 锐评 精准击中了当前LLM智能体在处理时序依赖和并行任务时的软肋——GPT-4o在异步任务上11%的惨淡成功率极具警醒意义。然而，仅用现有ReAct框架作为试金石略显单薄，真正缺乏的是针对异步时序推理机制本身的创新，而非仅仅造一个更难的关卡来证明现有方法不行。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.title: A/B Agent: A Self-Evolving Agent for Strategy Iteration in Industrial A/B Testing
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.short_review: 创新性地将工业场景的策略迭代转化为结构化知识管理系统，通过分层树状结构突破传统RAG的平铺式检索局限。但需警惕经验树构建过程中的冷启动问题，且未明确说明如何处理不同业务场景间的隐式依赖关系。相比HarnessCompass的组件解耦，其知识管理范式更适用于特定领域持续优化场景，泛化能力有待验证。

Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.title: MetaVideoAgent: Automated Video-Agent Evolution for Long-Form Video Understanding
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.short_review: 该论文直面长视频Agent演化中验证成本极高和失败跨阶段传播的痛点，提出的“最小验证任务”和“模块化失败归因”策略务实且具工程价值。然而，单次演化平均消耗3.54M tokens开销依然巨大，且模块归因机制高度依赖启发式规则的鲁棒性，在更为复杂的动态视频分布下，其失败归因的准确度与演化稳定性仍需进一步验证。

Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.title: AgentAntibody: An Adaptive Immune System for Defending LLM Agents against Prompt Injection
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.short_review: 该研究敏锐地捕捉到Agent安全中“用户意图模糊”这一核心痛点，通过引入进化与记忆机制，打破了传统防御“只见树木不见森林”的局限，为解决Prompt Injection提供了极具潜力的动态防御范式。然而，防御机制本身的“自进化”也潜藏着‘模型崩塌’或‘过度防御’的风险：若抗体库在演化初期遭受数据污染或对抗性欺骗，可能导致防御策略畸形化；且对于用户安全边界随时间发生非单调变化的场景（如临时授权），系统的遗忘与修正机制仍需进一步探讨。
