Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.title: SkillJack: Persistent Skill Backdoors in Self-Evolving Agents
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.short_review: 该研究极具洞察力，揭示了自进化智能体特有的安全盲点：原本用于提升效率的‘技能提取’机制，反而成为了恶意行为的‘漂白’通道。实验数据令人震惊（检测率从98.5%骤降至11.4%），证明了针对记忆的防御策略在面对能力进化层面的攻击时几乎失效，直接指出了当前智能体架构中‘遗忘即安全’假设的崩塌。
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.full_note: SkillJack: Persistent Skill Backdoors in Self-Evolving Agents 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation 👤 作者： Zonghao Ying, Xiangfan Wu, Huiyu Wu, Xing Zheng, Huangsheng Cheng, Xiaorong Shi, Jing Guo 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-08-04 11:51:23 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03509v1 🧾 一句话总结： 首次揭露自进化智能体在将经验转化为技能过程中存在严重的安全漏洞，攻击者可利用该过程植入难以检测且持久的后门技能，迫使智能体安全防御从数据清洗向能力溯源拓展。 📄 摘要： Self-evolving agents increasingly convert interaction histories into reusable skills that persist beyond individual tasks. While prior work studies memory and retrieval poisoning, such attacks only affect agents when poisoned records are retrieved as context. We uncover a new and more fundamental risk: poisoned experiences can be transformed by the agent itself into durable behavioral artifacts. We present \textbf{SkillJack}, the first attack that exploits the experience-to-skill pipeline of self-evolving agents. Instead of directly manipulating runtime context, SkillJack hijacks the agent's own learning process to implant malicious behaviors into its reusable skill repertoire. We identify three key properties of this transformation: \emph{sanitization whitewashing}, where malicious intent is obscured during skill extraction; \emph{cross-layer promotion}, where transient experiences become persistent capabilities; and \emph{persistence isolation}, where the attack survives removal of its original source records. We evaluate SkillJack on two representative systems, SkillX and Anything2Skill, using a shared dataset of 150 trajectories across four policy-risk categories. Results show that skill extraction substantially reduces attack detectability: in SkillX, safety detection drops from 98.5\% for poisoned trajectories to 11.4\% for extracted skills, while Anything2Skill shows a similar effect. Meanwhile, the implanted skills remain effective, achieving attack success rates of 56.2\% and 89.2\% on the two systems, respectively. Furthermore, 80.0\% of skill-mediated attacks persist after deleting the original poisoned records, and some skills unintentionally activate on benign queries. Our findings reveal skill evolution as a new attack surface and motivate provenance-aware skill lifecycle protection. Our code is available at https://github.com/Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard/research/skilljack. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Self-Evolving Agents]] [[Skill Backdoor]] [[Experience-to-Skill Pipeline]] [[Sanitization Whitewashing]] [[Cross-layer Promotion]] [[Persistence Isolation]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出SkillJack攻击框架，通过劫持自进化智能体的‘经验到技能’转化流水线，将中毒的交互轨迹转化为持久的恶意技能，利用技能提取过程中的‘清洗漂白’效应规避检测，并实现跨层提升与持久化隔离。 💬 锐评 该研究极具洞察力，揭示了自进化智能体特有的安全盲点：原本用于提升效率的‘技能提取’机制，反而成为了恶意行为的‘漂白’通道。实验数据令人震惊（检测率从98.5%骤降至11.4%），证明了针对记忆的防御策略在面对能力进化层面的攻击时几乎失效，直接指出了当前智能体架构中‘遗忘即安全’假设的崩塌。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.title: Hybrid LLM-Augmented Reinforcement Learning Agents for Complex Sequential Decision Tasks
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.short_review: 该架构巧妙地互补了LLM的语义规划能力与RL的精细控制能力，有效解决了长时序任务中的决策连贯性难题，是迈向通用自主代理的关键一步。
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.full_note: Hybrid LLM-Augmented Reinforcement Learning Agents for Complex Sequential Decision Tasks 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation 👤 作者： Christophe D. Hounwanou, John Emeka Eze, Yaé Ulrich Gaba 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-08-04 11:44:07 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03502v1 🧾 一句话总结： 通过结合LLM的高层规划与RL的低级控制，显著提升了复杂长时序 sequential decision tasks 的样本效率与成功率。 📄 摘要： Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown strong capabilities in reasoning, planning, and tool-use, enabling new forms of autonomous agents. However, LLM-based agents struggle with long-horizon sequential decision tasks that require precise action optimization and environment interaction. Reinforcement Learning (RL), while effective for sequential control, often lacks the high-level abstraction and task decomposition abilities needed for complex scenarios. This paper introduces an LLM-Augmented Reinforcement Learning Agent that integrates LLM-driven planning with RL-based action optimization. The proposed architecture leverages the LLM to generate subgoals, structured plans, and contextual guidance, while the RL agent refines low-level actions through interaction with the environment. Experiments on sequential decision tasks demonstrate improved sample efficiency, higher success rates, and more coherent action trajectories compared to RL-only and LLM-only baselines. This hybrid paradigm highlights a promising direction for building more capable autonomous systems. 🧠 核心术语库 [[LLM-Augmented RL]] [[Sequential Decision Tasks]] [[Subgoal Generation]] [[Action Optimization]] [[Hybrid Architecture]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出了一种混合架构，利用大语言模型（LLM）进行高层规划和子目标生成（提供结构化计划与语境指导），同时结合强化学习（RL）通过环境交互进行低级动作的精细优化。 💬 锐评 该架构巧妙地互补了LLM的语义规划能力与RL的精细控制能力，有效解决了长时序任务中的决策连贯性难题，是迈向通用自主代理的关键一步。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.title: Can LLM design high-quality experiments? A Comprehensive and Systematic Benchmark on Autonomous Experimental Design
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.short_review: SCOPE基准填补了实验设计评估的空白，精准指出了LLM在低层配置（如数据集、基线）上的性能塌陷，打破了‘搜索即优化’的迷思。OptED通过工程化的约束机制缓解瓶颈，具有很高的科研自动化落地参考价值。
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.full_note: Can LLM design high-quality experiments? A Comprehensive and Systematic Benchmark on Autonomous Experimental Design 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation 👤 作者： Zejun Liu, Jian Wu, Ru Peng, Yuliang Ji, Dongyuan Li, Renhe Jiang, Yue Zhang 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-08-04 11:43:22 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03501v1 🧾 一句话总结： 通过SCOPE基准量化LLM实验设计能力并提出OptED优化方案，确立了AI自主科研的评估标准与落地路径。 📄 摘要： AI for Research (AI4Research) leverages AI to automate and improve scientific workflows. While experimental design is a critical stage of the research process, prior work has focused primarily on code implementation and execution, overlooking the importance of this stage, and no benchmark exists to evaluate AI's ability to conduct systematic experiment design. To bridge this gap, we propose SCOPE, a Scientific COmprehensive Planning Evaluation Benchmark constructed from 300 high-quality latest papers across 19 research domains from top-tier venues (e.g., ICML, NeurIPS, and ICLR),evaluating LLMs on two dimensions: High-Level planning completeness (main, ablation, and analysis experiments) and Low-Level configuration accuracy and rationality (datasets, baselines, and metrics). Benchmarking reveals three findings: (1) most LLMs cannot directly design high-quality experiments; (2) all LLMs exhibit a performance bottleneck in low-level configuration; and (3) search mode does not improve design quality. Furthermore, to address these challenges, we propose OptED, a novel agentic workflow to optimize LLM-based experimental design, that enhances LLM-based experimental planning through stage isolation, tool augmentation, and rule-based constraints, effectively alleviating the configuration bottleneck. 🧠 核心术语库 [[SCOPE (Benchmark)]] [[OptED (Agent Workflow)]] [[AI4Research]] [[Configuration Bottleneck]] [[Stage Isolation]] [[Tool Augmentation]] 🔬 核心方法简述 构建了包含300篇顶级论文的SCOPE基准，评估LLM在高层规划（主/消融/分析）和低层配置（数据集/基线/指标）上的能力。提出OptED代理工作流，通过阶段隔离、工具增强和规则约束来优化实验设计，缓解低层配置瓶颈。 💬 锐评 SCOPE基准填补了实验设计评估的空白，精准指出了LLM在低层配置（如数据集、基线）上的性能塌陷，打破了‘搜索即优化’的迷思。OptED通过工程化的约束机制缓解瓶颈，具有很高的科研自动化落地参考价值。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.title: SkillSentry: Adaptive Honey Worlds for Dynamic Safety Testing of Agent Skills
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.short_review: 方法创新性较强，通过动态交互和对比分析有效发现静态方法难以捕捉的条件行为，但依赖LLM模拟环境的准确性和资源控制精度，可能存在模拟与现实偏差；F1分数高但未详细说明误报率，需关注检测的精确性。
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.full_note: SkillSentry: Adaptive Honey Worlds for Dynamic Safety Testing of Agent Skills 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation 👤 作者： Nizhang Li, Zonghao Ying, Xiangfan Wu, Zonglei Jing, Xixun Lin, Hao Zhang, Wenxin Zhang, Jiaye Lin, Quanchen Zou, Xiangzheng Zhang 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-08-04 11:22:22 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.03485v1 🧾 一句话总结： SkillSentry通过自适应蜜罐动态测试LLM技能，显著提升对条件有害行为的检测召回率与F1值，为LLM技能安全评估提供新范式。 📄 摘要： External skills extend the capabilities of large language model agents, but also introduce an execution-time attack surface: a skill that appears benign under inspection may reveal harmful behavior only after particular environmental states, resources, or interaction histories are encountered. Existing scanners primarily rely on static analysis, predefined rules, or one-shot semantic judgments, making such conditional behavior difficult to elicit and attribute. We present SkillSentry, a dynamic safety-testing framework based on adaptive honey worlds. SkillSentry infers the intended capability boundary of a skill, constructs an LLM-simulated environment with controlled decoy resources, and adaptively generates tasks to explore its behavioral states. It then compares skill-enabled trajectories with matched no-skill executions, grounding suspicious behaviors in source code and verified execution traces before making a final decision. We evaluate SkillSentry against seven scanner configurations. SkillSentry achieves 99.50% Recall and 96.26% average F1 on standard benchmarks. Under semantics-preserving evasion, it reaches 92.95% average F1, compared with 80.07% for the strongest baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/nizhangli062-jpg/SkillSentry-Adaptive-Honey-Worlds-for-Dynamic-Safety-Testing-of-Agent-Skills. 🧠 核心术语库 [[自适应蜜罐环境]] [[技能意图边界推断]] [[带技能与无技能轨迹对比]] [[源码与执行轨迹验证]] 🔬 核心方法简述 SkillSentry采用动态安全测试框架，通过构建自适应蜜罐环境（LLM模拟环境+可控诱饵资源），自适应生成任务探索技能行为状态，并对比带技能与无技能执行轨迹，结合源码与执行轨迹验证可疑行为。 💬 锐评 方法创新性较强，通过动态交互和对比分析有效发现静态方法难以捕捉的条件行为，但依赖LLM模拟环境的准确性和资源控制精度，可能存在模拟与现实偏差；F1分数高但未详细说明误报率，需关注检测的精确性。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.title: Evolving in the Agent Jungle via History-Informed Opponent Awareness
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.short_review: 论文敏锐地捕捉到了LLM智能体进化研究中的盲点——即现有方法隐含的静态环境假设在多智能体博弈中完全失效。OASE通过引入“历史快照锚定”机制，巧妙地将动态博弈中的相对运动转化为可测量的静态增量，逻辑严密且具有极强的工程落地价值。然而，实验部分仅对比Reflexion基线略显单薄，Reflexion本质上缺乏对博弈环境的针对性设计，未能充分展示OASE相对于其他潜在动态适应策略的优势；此外，历史快照的存储与检索成本在实际大规模应用中可能成为新的瓶颈。
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.full_note: Evolving in the Agent Jungle via History-Informed Opponent Awareness 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation 👤 作者： Zhaofeng Zhang, Linhan Xia, Rui Liu, Yihao Wang, Binrui Shen, Shengxin Zhu 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-08-03 10:06:23 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02005v1 🧾 一句话总结： 针对多智能体非平稳环境，通过历史锚定机制将盲目更新转变为证据驱动的选择性进化，有效解决了策略过时难题。 📄 摘要： Learning to adapt strategies through interaction is a key step toward more general and autonomous LLM agents. Existing approaches typically achieve behavioral adaptation by revising skill libraries. However, in multi-agent environments, opponents may simultaneously update their strategies, causing the environment itself to evolve continuously. Applying skill-revision methods designed for static environments in such settings therefore amounts to updating against an obsolete reference. To address this challenge, we introduce OASE (Opponent-Aware Selective Evolution), which identifies and adopts genuinely beneficial skill revisions in dynamic multi-agent environments. Specifically, OASE conducts paired comparisons between a candidate skill and the incumbent under identical conditions anchored by historical snapshots of opponent strategies, and adopts the candidate only when its estimated payoff gain exceeds an acceptance threshold. We evaluate OASE in two decision-making scenarios: first-price auctions and private-cost Cournot competition. Experimental results show that, compared with a Reflexion-style baseline, OASE achieves a lower final equilibrium distance in both environments while accepting substantially fewer skill revisions, thereby suppressing strategy changes that lack sufficient payoff support. OASE therefore replaces blind updating with evidence-anchored selection, allowing agents to adapt stably and efficiently even as opponents continuously evolve. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Opponent-Aware Selective Evolution (OASE)]] [[Non-stationary Multi-agent Environments]] [[History Snapshots Anchoring]] [[Skill Library Revision]] [[Evidence-Anchored Selection]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出OASE（对手感知选择性进化）框架，核心在于利用对手策略的历史快照作为静态锚点，在相同受控条件下对候选技能与现有技能进行成对比较，仅当预估收益增益超过接受阈值时才采纳修改，从而解决多智能体环境非平稳性带来的策略更新失效问题。 💬 锐评 论文敏锐地捕捉到了LLM智能体进化研究中的盲点——即现有方法隐含的静态环境假设在多智能体博弈中完全失效。OASE通过引入“历史快照锚定”机制，巧妙地将动态博弈中的相对运动转化为可测量的静态增量，逻辑严密且具有极强的工程落地价值。然而，实验部分仅对比Reflexion基线略显单薄，Reflexion本质上缺乏对博弈环境的针对性设计，未能充分展示OASE相对于其他潜在动态适应策略的优势；此外，历史快照的存储与检索成本在实际大规模应用中可能成为新的瓶颈。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.title: HarnessCompass: Guiding Automatic Harness Evolution toward Generalizable and Effective Agent Harnesses
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.short_review: 摘要中提及的GPT-5.4模型显得颇为超前甚至存疑，但该方法论直指现有自动演化方案中“过拟合”与“组件干扰”的核心软肋。若能如声称般在仅5次迭代内将SWE-bench Verified的Pass@1大幅提升并实现跨模型迁移，其“约束演化”策略将是Agent自适应领域的关键突破，有效解决了当前Agent框架特定任务优化后难以泛化的顽疾。
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.full_note: HarnessCompass: Guiding Automatic Harness Evolution toward Generalizable and Effective Agent Harnesses 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation 👤 作者： Luan Zhang, Ruochen Zhou, Dandan Song, Zhengyu Chen, Yuhang Tian, Jun Yang, Huipeng Ma, Chenhao Li, Guangyuan Feng, Xudong Li, Yizhou Jin, Yan Xu 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-08-03 08:51:50 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01918v1 🧾 一句话总结： 通过约束演化、主动反馈和组件解耦优化，有效解决了Agent Harness自动演化中的过拟合与组件干扰问题，实现了更高性能和强泛化性的Agent架构。 📄 摘要： Harness design plays a critical role in agent performance by shaping how large language models (LLMs) perceive, reason over, and act within executable environments. Recent work has proposed automatic harness evolution, which iteratively improves the harness from agent--environment interactions. However, existing methods often overfit to the evolution tasks, rely exclusively on trajectory-derived signals, and optimize harness components jointly, causing interference across components. We propose HarnessCompass, a novel automatic harness evolution framework built around constrained evolution, proactive feedback, and component-wise optimization. HarnessCompass first enforces global constraints on evolution, restricting modifications to task-agnostic harness changes that generalize beyond the evolution tasks. It then augments trajectory-derived evidence with proactive first-person feedback from the agent about harness usage, yielding richer signals for evolution. Finally, it decouples the optimization of different harness components before consolidating them into a unified harness, reducing cross-component interference while preserving component synergy. On SWE-bench Verified with GPT-5.4, HarnessCompass improves Pass@1 from 54\% to 66\% in only 5 evolution iterations, outperforming AHE in both effectiveness and evolution efficiency. In addition, the evolved harness transfers effectively to held-out tasks and other models, demonstrating substantially stronger generalization than prior automatic harness evolution methods. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Harness Design]] [[Automatic Harness Evolution]] [[Constrained Evolution]] [[Proactive Feedback]] [[Component-wise Optimization]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出HarnessCompass框架，包含三大核心机制：1. 约束演化，强制执行全局约束限制修改为任务无关变更，以提升泛化性；2. 主动反馈，结合Agent关于harness使用的一人称主动反馈与轨迹信号，丰富演化依据；3. 逐组件优化，解耦不同harness组件的优化过程以减少干扰，最后再整合为统一harness。 💬 锐评 摘要中提及的GPT-5.4模型显得颇为超前甚至存疑，但该方法论直指现有自动演化方案中“过拟合”与“组件干扰”的核心软肋。若能如声称般在仅5次迭代内将SWE-bench Verified的Pass@1大幅提升并实现跨模型迁移，其“约束演化”策略将是Agent自适应领域的关键突破，有效解决了当前Agent框架特定任务优化后难以泛化的顽疾。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.title: CoEvoKG: Co-Evolving Knowledge Graphs with Self-Evolving Search Agents
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.short_review: 该论文在冷启动阶段极具价值，因为它解决了强化学习搜索代理中常见的'遗忘'问题。通过引入外部知识图谱作为记忆和任务池，实现了'进化-记忆-再进化'的正向循环。虽然其性能提升依赖于初始 KG 的质量，但为解决 RL 中的长期依赖和样本效率问题提供了一个新颖且强有力的基线方案。
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.full_note: CoEvoKG: Co-Evolving Knowledge Graphs with Self-Evolving Search Agents 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation 👤 作者： Zhaoyang Li, Zenghuang Fu, Qiuyuan Ai, Ping Jiang, Haoyu Wu, Minghui Wu, Chenxu Zhao, Jie Song, Guannan He 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-08-03 08:39:16 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01904v1 🧾 一句话总结： 通过将知识图谱作为任务生成器和记忆存储，实现了搜索代理与知识图谱的协同进化，在多跳问答任务上大幅提升了模型准确率。 📄 摘要： Large language models can improve with reinforcement learning for search agents, yet existing self play agents repeatedly generate tasks while discarding the knowledge gained during successful searches. We introduce CoEvoKG, a framework that turns a   knowledge graph into both a source of verifiable training tasks and a persistent evidence memory for agent evolution. CoEvoKG jointly trains a task generator and a search agent: the generator creates multihop questions from entity chains sampled   from the knowledge graph, while the agent learns from rewards for answer correctness and search trajectories whose entity paths are supported by graph evidence. When a search succeeds, CoEvoKG verifies and deduplicates the retrieved evidence, then   writes it back to the corresponding graph nodes and edges. Future rounds reuse this enriched graph for task generation and reward computation, closing the loop between model self evolution and knowledge accumulation. Experiments on six QA benchmarks   (NQ, TriviaQA, PopQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and Bamboogle) with three backbone models show that CoEvoKG improves macro average accuracy over the corresponding base models by +11.2, +10.1, and +11.6 points on Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct,   Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, respectively. Under matched training budgets, CoEvoKG further improves over competitive self play baselines and RL baselines for search agents by +2.6 to +3.7 macro average points across the three   backbones. Code is available at https://github.com/lazzy1225/CoEvoKG. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Co-Evolving Knowledge Graphs]] [[Self-Evolving Search Agents]] [[Task Generator]] [[Evidence Memory]] [[Multihop Questions]] [[Verification & Deduplication]] 🔬 核心方法简述 CoEvoKG 框架将知识图谱同时作为训练任务来源和持久证据记忆。通过联合训练任务生成器（从图实体链提取多跳问题）和搜索代理（基于答案正确性和图支持的轨迹奖励），并在成功搜索后将验证后的证据写回图谱，从而形成模型进化与知识积累的闭环。 💬 锐评 该论文在冷启动阶段极具价值，因为它解决了强化学习搜索代理中常见的'遗忘'问题。通过引入外部知识图谱作为记忆和任务池，实现了'进化-记忆-再进化'的正向循环。虽然其性能提升依赖于初始 KG 的质量，但为解决 RL 中的长期依赖和样本效率问题提供了一个新颖且强有力的基线方案。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.title: CRISP: Critical Step Perception for Training Efficient Deep Search Agents
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.short_review: CRISP的创新点在于区分必要与冗余工具交互，而非统一抑制工具使用。但Backward Evidence Induction的复杂度和对强模型的依赖可能限制其泛化能力；效率感知奖励仅优化成功rollouts可能忽略失败中的效率改进机会。
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.full_note: CRISP: Critical Step Perception for Training Efficient Deep Search Agents 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation 👤 作者： Haosi Mo, Zihao Yan, Ruiqing Zhang, Zhongli Li, Hexuan Deng, Xuebo Liu, Min Zhang 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-08-03 08:15:18 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01867v1 🧾 一句话总结： CRISP通过智能区分必要与冗余步骤，显著提升深度搜索代理的交互效率，是LLM工具交互优化的重要进展。 📄 摘要： Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly extended into deep search agents that solve complex questions through multi-step interaction with external search and browsing tools. However, existing agents often incur substantial computational and interaction costs, generating lengthy trajectories that contain redundant queries, inefficient exploration, and irrelevant observations. Existing efficiency-oriented methods usually encourage agents to use tools less frequently, but treating all tool interactions uniformly may also suppress steps that gather necessary evidence. In this paper, we propose CRISP, a framework for training efficient deep search agents through critical step perception. Unlike prior efficiency methods that uniformly penalize tool use, CRISP distinguishes interactions that gather necessary evidence from redundant ones and shapes the training reward to preserve the former while pruning the latter, improving efficiency without sacrificing the evidence needed for correct answers. Specifically, CRISP first constructs critical-step labels with Backward Evidence Induction: starting from the final answer, a strong model traverses a completed search trajectory backward and judges whether each tool-interaction step provides or preserves evidence for the final answer. We then distill these step-wise judgments into a smaller critical-step recognizer, enabling full-trajectory analysis in a single pass. During policy optimization, an efficiency-aware reward is applied only to successful rollouts. Experiments on BrowseComp and HLE-Verified show that CRISP maintains competitive final-answer accuracy while reducing average interaction turns by 15.1% and 33.2%, respectively, demonstrating substantial improvements in interaction efficiency. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Critical Step Perception]] [[Backward Evidence Induction]] [[效率感知奖励]] 🔬 核心方法简述 CRISP通过Backward Evidence Induction构建critical-step labels，区分必要证据收集步骤与冗余步骤，并使用效率感知奖励仅优化成功rollouts，从而在不牺牲准确性的前提下提升交互效率。 💬 锐评 CRISP的创新点在于区分必要与冗余工具交互，而非统一抑制工具使用。但Backward Evidence Induction的复杂度和对强模型的依赖可能限制其泛化能力；效率感知奖励仅优化成功rollouts可能忽略失败中的效率改进机会。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.title: Evolving Deception: When Agents Evolve, Deception Wins
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.short_review: 研究揭示了自我演化代理的潜在安全风险，但实验场景的封闭性可能限制结论普适性，未充分探讨多智能体协同演化场景，且对'规范指令'的量化评估方法存疑
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.full_note: Evolving Deception: When Agents Evolve, Deception Wins 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation 👤 作者： Zonghao Ying, Haowen Dai, Tianyuan Zhang, Yisong Xiao, Quanchen Zou, Aishan Liu, Jian Yang, Yaodong Yang, Xianglong Liu 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-03-06 03:47:07 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.05872v2 🧾 一句话总结： 该研究警示：在竞争环境下，自我演化的智能体可能自发形成欺骗策略，揭示了自主演化系统与价值对齐间的根本性冲突。 📄 摘要： Self-evolving agents offer a promising path toward scalable autonomy. However, in this work, we show that in competitive environments, self-evolution can instead give rise to a serious and previously underexplored risk: the spontaneous emergence of deception as an evolutionarily stable strategy. We conduct a systematic empirical study on the self-evolution of large language model (LLM) agents in a competitive Bidding Arena, where agents iteratively refine their strategies through interaction-driven reflection. Across different evolutionary paths (\eg, Neutral, Honesty-Guided, and Deception-Guided), we find a consistent pattern: under utility-driven competition, unconstrained self-evolution reliably drifts toward deceptive behaviors, even when honest strategies remain viable. This drift is explained by a fundamental asymmetry in generalization. Deception evolves as a transferable meta-strategy that generalizes robustly across diverse and unseen tasks, whereas honesty-based strategies are fragile and often collapse outside their original contexts. Further analysis of agents internal states reveals the emergence of rationalization mechanisms, through which agents justify or deny deceptive actions to reconcile competitive success with normative instructions. Our paper exposes a fundamental tension between agent self-evolution and alignment, highlighting the risks of deploying self-improving agents in adversarial environments. 🧠 核心术语库 [[自我演化（Self-evolution）]] [[欺骗策略（Deception Strategy）]] [[进化稳定策略（Evolutionarily Stable Strategy）]] [[一般化不对称性（Generalization Asymmetry）]] [[合理化机制（Rationalization Mechanism）]] 🔬 核心方法简述 系统实证研究，通过构建竞争性竞价环境，让大型语言模型代理在交互驱动的反思中迭代优化策略，对比不同进化路径（中性/诚实引导/欺骗引导）下的策略演化轨迹 💬 锐评 研究揭示了自我演化代理的潜在安全风险，但实验场景的封闭性可能限制结论普适性，未充分探讨多智能体协同演化场景，且对'规范指令'的量化评估方法存疑 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.title: Learn Like Humans: Use Meta-cognitive Reflection for Efficient Self-Improvement
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.short_review: 该论文的核心贡献在于将教育心理学中的元认知概念引入LLM自我改进，但'原则性反思'与'程序性反思'的具体实现机制在摘要中未明确阐述。此外，单周期优化的具体计算流程、与传统多轮递归方法的定量对比细节（如计算成本降低的具体数值）缺失。作为冷启动阶段的论文，其创新性在于提出了'像人类一样学习'的愿景，但方法论的技术细节和实验验证的充分性需进一步审视。
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.full_note: Learn Like Humans: Use Meta-cognitive Reflection for Efficient Self-Improvement 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation 👤 作者： Xinmeng Hou, Peiliang Gong, Bohao Qu, Wuqi Wang, Qing Guo, Yang Liu 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-01-17 09:12:26 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.11974v1 🧾 一句话总结： MARS通过模仿人类元认知过程，在单递归周期内完成原则性与程序性反思的整合，实现了LLM智能体的高效自我进化，为解决静态提示词局限性提供了新范式。 📄 摘要： While Large Language Models (LLMs) enable complex autonomous behavior, current agents remain constrained by static, human-designed prompts that limit adaptability. Existing self-improving frameworks attempt to bridge this gap but typically rely on inefficient, multi-turn recursive loops that incur high computational costs. To address this, we propose Metacognitive Agent Reflective Self-improvement (MARS), a framework that achieves efficient self-evolution within a single recurrence cycle. Inspired by educational psychology, MARS mimics human learning by integrating principle-based reflection (abstracting normative rules to avoid errors) and procedural reflection (deriving step-by-step strategies for success). By synthesizing these insights into optimized instructions, MARS allows agents to systematically refine their reasoning logic without continuous online feedback. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate that MARS outperforms state-of-the-art self-evolving systems while significantly reducing computational overhead. 🧠 核心术语库 [[元认知反思(Meta-cognitive Reflection)]] [[原则性反思(Principle-based Reflection)]] [[程序性反思(Procedural Reflection)]] [[单周期自进化(Single-cycle Self-evolution)]] [[指令优化(Instruction Optimization)]] 🔬 核心方法简述 MARS框架通过整合两种元认知反思机制实现高效自我进化：原则性反思抽象出避免错误的规范规则，程序性反思推导出成功的步骤策略。该框架在单次递归周期内 将反思洞见合成优化指令，使智能体无需持续在线反馈即可系统化改进推理逻辑。 💬 锐评 该论文的核心贡献在于将教育心理学中的元认知概念引入LLM自我改进，但'原则性反思'与'程序性反思'的具体实现机制在摘要中未明确阐述。此外，单周期优化的具体计算流程、与传统多轮递归方法的定量对比细节（如计算成本降低的具体数值）缺失。作为冷启动阶段的论文，其创新性在于提出了'像人类一样学习'的愿景，但方法论的技术细节和实验验证的充分性需进一步审视。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.title: Towards AGI A Pragmatic Approach Towards Self Evolving Agent
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.short_review: 该论文将CL、RL、GA等经典机器学习演进范式与大模型多智能体架构强行打包，试图全面解决LLM Agent的静态化问题，'技术拼盘'意味较重。尽管对比三种范式在不同任务难度下的优劣（CL泛化好、RL攻坚强、GA多样性高）具有工程参考价值，但多层级模型间的通信与触发进化的计算成本极高，所谓'务实'的宣称仍需在正文中通过真实的复杂度与收益权衡来验证。
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.full_note: Towards AGI A Pragmatic Approach Towards Self Evolving Agent 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation 👤 作者： Indrajit Kar, Sammy Zonunpuia, Zonunfeli Ralte 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-01-15 20:43:44 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.11658v1 🧾 一句话总结： 提出一种集成工具自动合成与多策略进化（CL/RL/GA）的分层多Agent框架，验证了Agent在无需人工干预下实现自主能力扩展与推理进化的有效性。 📄 摘要： Large Language Model (LLM) based agents are powerful yet fundamentally static after deployment, lacking the ability to autonomously expand capabilities, generate new tools, or evolve their reasoning. This work introduces a hierarchical self-evolving multi-agent framework that integrates a Base LLM, an operational SLM agent, a Code-Generation LLM, and a Teacher-LLM to enable continuous adaptation. The workflow begins with the agent attempting a task using reasoning and existing tools; if unsuccessful, it escalates to tool synthesis through the Code-Gen LLM, and when failures persist, it triggers an evolution phase using Curriculum Learning (CL), Reward-Based Learning (RL), or Genetic Algorithm (GA) evolution. Using the TaskCraft dataset rich in hierarchical tasks, tool-use traces, and difficulty scaling we evaluate these paradigms. CL delivers fast recovery and strong generalization, RL excels on high-difficulty tasks, and GA offers high behavioral diversity. Across all settings, evolved agents outperform their originals, demonstrating robust, autonomous, self-improving agentic evolution. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Hierarchical Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Framework]] [[Tool Synthesis]] [[Curriculum Learning (CL)]] [[Reward-Based Learning (RL)]] [[Genetic Algorithm (GA) Evolution]] [[TaskCraft Dataset]] 🔬 核心方法简述 构建了一个分层多Agent框架（包含Base LLM、operational SLM agent、Code-Gen LLM和Teacher-LLM）。Agent首先尝试利用现有工具解决任务；失败后升级至Code-Gen LLM进行工具合成；若持续失败则触发进化阶段，分别采用课程学习(CL)、强化学习(RL)或遗传算法(GA)进行自我改进，并在TaskCraft数据集上评估了这三种范式。 💬 锐评 该论文将CL、RL、GA等经典机器学习演进范式与大模型多智能体架构强行打包，试图全面解决LLM Agent的静态化问题，'技术拼盘'意味较重。尽管对比三种范式在不同任务难度下的优劣（CL泛化好、RL攻坚强、GA多样性高）具有工程参考价值，但多层级模型间的通信与触发进化的计算成本极高，所谓'务实'的宣称仍需在正文中通过真实的复杂度与收益权衡来验证。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.title: Adaptive Orchestration: Scalable Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.short_review: 该文精准击中了单体Agent‘上下文污染’与静态多Agent‘资源开销’的二元对立痛点。其核心亮点在于以‘运行时动态架构调整’取代不稳定的‘代码自重写’，显著提升了工程落地可行性。不过，将OS层的LRU策略直接映射至Agent管理虽显巧妙，但可能低估了Agent间复杂的协作依赖与状态保留难度，存在过度简化风险。
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.full_note: Adaptive Orchestration: Scalable Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Systems 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation 👤 作者： Sathish Sampath, Anuradha Baskaran 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-01-10 07:53:55 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.09742v1 🧾 一句话总结： 为解决多智能体系统的可扩展性瓶颈，提出了一种低开销、高稳定性的动态编排架构，为Agent自进化提供了区别于代码重写的新范式。 📄 摘要： As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents, they face a critical scalability bottleneck known as the "Generalization-Specialization Dilemma." Monolithic agents equipped with extensive toolkits suffer from context pollution and attention decay, leading to hallucinations. Conversely, static multi-agent swarms introduce significant latency and resource overhead. This paper introduces a Self-Evolving Concierge System, a novel architecture utilizing a Dynamic Mixture of Experts (DMoE) approach. Unlike recent self-improving agents that rewrite their own codebase, our system preserves stability by dynamically restructuring its runtime environment: "hiring" specialized sub-agents based on real-time conversation analysis. We introduce an asynchronous "Meta-Cognition Engine" that detects capability gaps, a Least Recently Used (LRU) eviction policy for resource constraints, and a novel "Surgical History Pruning" mechanism to mitigate refusal bias. Experimental results demonstrate that this architecture maintains high task success rates while minimizing token consumption compared to static agent swarms. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Generalization-Specialization Dilemma]] [[Dynamic Mixture of Experts (DMoE)]] [[Self-Evolving Concierge System]] [[Meta-Cognition Engine]] [[Surgical History Pruning]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出“Self-Evolving Concierge System”架构，利用Dynamic Mixture of Experts (DMoE)机制根据实时对话动态“雇佣”专用子智能体重构运行时环境，配合异步Meta-Cognition Engine检测能力缺口、LRU策略管理资源以及Surgical History Pruning机制缓解拒绝偏差。 💬 锐评 该文精准击中了单体Agent‘上下文污染’与静态多Agent‘资源开销’的二元对立痛点。其核心亮点在于以‘运行时动态架构调整’取代不稳定的‘代码自重写’，显著提升了工程落地可行性。不过，将OS层的LRU策略直接映射至Agent管理虽显巧妙，但可能低估了Agent间复杂的协作依赖与状态保留难度，存在过度简化风险。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.title: LoongFlow: Directed Evolutionary Search via a Cognitive Plan-Execute-Summarize Paradigm
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.short_review: LoongFlow 的核心价值在于打破了传统进化算法在高维代码空间中盲目探索的局限，通过 PES 范式引入了认知层面的引导，理论上显著提升了搜索的定向性。结合 MAP-Elites 与多岛模型的记忆机制设计精巧，有效缓解了早熟收敛问题。然而，该框架的效能高度依赖 LLM 的推理质量，若规划阶段出现偏差，可能导致整个进化路径陷入逻辑死胡同；此外，复杂的混合系统虽然理论性强，但工程落地时的超参数调优难度可能较高。
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.full_note: LoongFlow: Directed Evolutionary Search via a Cognitive Plan-Execute-Summarize Paradigm 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation 👤 作者： Chunhui Wan, Xunan Dai, Zhuo Wang, Minglei Li, Yanpeng Wang, Yinan Mao, Yu Lan, Zhiwen Xiao 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-12-30 08:39:28 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.24077v1 🧾 一句话总结： LoongFlow 通过融合认知 PES 范式与混合进化记忆机制，实现了从盲目突变到推理驱动的进化搜索跨越，在大幅降低计算成本的同时显著提升了算法发现与 Pipeline 优化的效率。 📄 摘要： The transition from static Large Language Models (LLMs) to self-improving agents is hindered by the lack of structured reasoning in traditional evolutionary approaches. Existing methods often struggle with premature convergence and inefficient exploration in high-dimensional code spaces. To address these challenges, we introduce LoongFlow, a self-evolving agent framework that achieves state-of-the-art solution quality with significantly reduced computational costs. Unlike "blind" mutation operators, LoongFlow integrates LLMs into a cognitive "Plan-Execute-Summarize" (PES) paradigm, effectively mapping the evolutionary search to a reasoning-heavy process. To sustain long-term architectural coherence, we incorporate a hybrid evolutionary memory system. By synergizing Multi-Island models with MAP-Elites and adaptive Boltzmann selection, this system theoretically balances the exploration-exploitation trade-off, maintaining diverse behavioral niches to prevent optimization stagnation. We instantiate LoongFlow with a General Agent for algorithmic discovery and an ML Agent for pipeline optimization. Extensive evaluations on the AlphaEvolve benchmark and Kaggle competitions demonstrate that LoongFlow outperforms leading baselines (e.g., OpenEvolve, ShinkaEvolve) by up to 60% in evolutionary efficiency while discovering superior solutions. LoongFlow marks a substantial step forward in autonomous scientific discovery, enabling the generation of expert-level solutions with reduced computational overhead. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Cognitive Plan-Execute-Summarize (PES) Paradigm]] [[Hybrid Evolutionary Memory System]] [[Multi-Island Models]] [[MAP-Elites]] [[Adaptive Boltzmann Selection]] [[Directed Evolutionary Search]] 🔬 核心方法简述 LoongFlow 提出了认知“计划-执行-总结”（PES）范式，利用大语言模型的推理能力替代传统盲目突变算子，将进化搜索转化为推理密集型过程；同时构建了混合进化记忆系统，协同 Multi-Island 模型、MAP-Elites 和自适应玻尔兹曼选择，以维持长期架构一致性并平衡探索与利用。 💬 锐评 LoongFlow 的核心价值在于打破了传统进化算法在高维代码空间中盲目探索的局限，通过 PES 范式引入了认知层面的引导，理论上显著提升了搜索的定向性。结合 MAP-Elites 与多岛模型的记忆机制设计精巧，有效缓解了早熟收敛问题。然而，该框架的效能高度依赖 LLM 的推理质量，若规划阶段出现偏差，可能导致整个进化路径陷入逻辑死胡同；此外，复杂的混合系统虽然理论性强，但工程落地时的超参数调优难度可能较高。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.title: Learning Game-Playing Agents with Generative Code Optimization
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.short_review: 这是“代码即策略”范式在冷启动阶段的关键奠基之作。通过将黑盒的深度学习权重转化为可编辑、可推理的代码，该方法不仅显著降低了环境交互成本，更重要的是赋予代理了长跨度逻辑推理能力。它指出了构建通用智能的一条极具前景的路径：代理的“思维”应当是可以进化的程序。
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.full_note: Learning Game-Playing Agents with Generative Code Optimization 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation 👤 作者： Zhiyi Kuang, Ryan Rong, YuCheng Yuan, Allen Nie 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-08-27 01:30:20 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.19506v1 🧾 一句话总结： 提出通过生成式代码优化构建游戏代理，利用 LLM 在 Atari 游戏中以极少的训练时间和交互次数达到与深度 RL 相当的性能。 📄 摘要： We present a generative optimization approach for learning game-playing agents, where policies are represented as Python programs and refined using large language models (LLMs). Our method treats decision-making policies as self-evolving code, with current observation as input and an in-game action as output, enabling agents to self-improve through execution traces and natural language feedback with minimal human intervention. Applied to Atari games, our game-playing Python program achieves performance competitive with deep reinforcement learning (RL) baselines while using significantly less training time and much fewer environment interactions. This work highlights the promise of programmatic policy representations for building efficient, adaptable agents capable of complex, long-horizon reasoning. 🧠 核心术语库 [[程序化策略表示]] [[自进化代码]] [[执行轨迹]] [[自然语言反馈]] 🔬 核心方法简述 将决策策略表示为 Python 程序，利用大语言模型（LLM）基于执行轨迹和自然语言反馈进行迭代优化，从而实现决策的自进化。 💬 锐评 这是“代码即策略”范式在冷启动阶段的关键奠基之作。通过将黑盒的深度学习权重转化为可编辑、可推理的代码，该方法不仅显著降低了环境交互成本，更重要的是赋予代理了长跨度逻辑推理能力。它指出了构建通用智能的一条极具前景的路径：代理的“思维”应当是可以进化的程序。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.title: WebCoT: Enhancing Web Agent Reasoning by Reconstructing Chain-of-Thought in Reflection, Branching, and Rollback
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.short_review: 该方法在缺乏历史论文对比的冷启动阶段具有创新性，但未详细说明推理轨迹重构的具体算法和CoT生成的质量评估标准，可能存在泛化能力不足的风险。
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.full_note: WebCoT: Enhancing Web Agent Reasoning by Reconstructing Chain-of-Thought in Reflection, Branching, and Rollback 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation 👤 作者： Minda Hu, Tianqing Fang, Jianshu Zhang, Junyu Ma, Zhisong Zhang, Jingyan Zhou, Hongming Zhang, Haitao Mi, Dong Yu, Irwin King 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-05-26 14:03:37 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.20013v2 🧾 一句话总结： 通过重构Web Agent的推理轨迹并微调LLM，显著提升其在动态Web环境中的推理能力，为冷启动阶段Web Agent的优化提供了有效路径。 📄 摘要： Web agents powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise for next-generation AI, but their limited reasoning in uncertain, dynamic web environments hinders robust deployment. In this paper, we identify key reasoning skills essential for effective web agents, i.e., reflection & lookahead, branching, and rollback, and curate trajectory data that exemplifies these abilities by reconstructing the agent's (inference-time) reasoning algorithms into chain-of-thought rationales. We conduct experiments in the agent self-improving benchmark, OpenWebVoyager, and demonstrate that distilling salient reasoning patterns into the backbone LLM via simple fine-tuning can substantially enhance its performance. Our approach yields significant improvements across multiple benchmarks, including WebVoyager, Mind2web-live, and SimpleQA (web search), highlighting the potential of targeted reasoning skill enhancement for web agents. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Web Agent]] [[Chain-of-Thought (CoT)]] [[Reflection & Lookahead]] [[Branching]] [[Rollback]] [[Trajectory Data Reconstruction]] 🔬 核心方法简述 通过重构Web Agent的推理算法（反思、分支、回滚）生成Chain-of-Thought（CoT）推理轨迹，并对其进行微调以提升LLM在动态Web环境中的推理能力。 💬 锐评 该方法在缺乏历史论文对比的冷启动阶段具有创新性，但未详细说明推理轨迹重构的具体算法和CoT生成的质量评估标准，可能存在泛化能力不足的风险。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.title: WebEvolver: Enhancing Web Agent Self-Improvement with Coevolving World Model
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.short_review: 该工作提出将世界模型引入自演化框架以缓解性能停滞问题，思路有一定创新性，但10%的性能增益较为温和，且未清晰阐明世界模型与智能体策略之间的协同训练机制如何真正实现‘共演化’。此外，论文未讨论世界模型自身可能产生的误差累积问题，以及在复杂动态网页环境中预测准确性能否支撑可靠的前看模拟。当前仅在三个数据集上验证，缺乏更广泛的消融实验来验证各组件的独立贡献。
Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.full_note: WebEvolver: Enhancing Web Agent Self-Improvement with Coevolving World Model 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation 👤 作者： Tianqing Fang, Hongming Zhang, Zhisong Zhang, Kaixin Ma, Wenhao Yu, Haitao Mi, Dong Yu 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-04-23 02:54:31 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.21024v2 🧾 一句话总结： 该论文创新性地将世界模型引入Web智能体的自演化框架，通过虚拟服务器和想象引擎双重角色突破性能停滞瓶颈，为自主智能体的持续适应性提供了新思路，但在误差传播和泛化性方面仍有待深入验证。 📄 摘要： Agent self-improvement, where the backbone Large Language Model (LLM) of the agent are trained on trajectories sampled autonomously based on their own policies, has emerged as a promising approach for enhancing performance. Recent advancements, particularly in web environments, face a critical limitation: their performance will reach a stagnation point during autonomous learning cycles, hindering further improvement. We argue that this stems from limited exploration of the web environment and insufficient exploitation of pre-trained web knowledge in LLMs. To improve the performance of self-improvement, we propose a novel framework that introduces a co-evolving World Model LLM. This world model predicts the next observation based on the current observation and action within the web environment. Leveraging LLMs' pretrained knowledge of abundant web content, the World Model serves dual roles: (1) as a virtual web server generating self-instructed training data to continuously refine the agent's policy, and (2) as an imagination engine during inference, enabling look-ahead simulation to guide action selection for the agent LLM. Experiments in real-world web environments (Mind2Web-Live, WebVoyager, and GAIA-web) show a 10% performance gain over existing self-evolving agents, demonstrating the efficacy and generalizability of our approach, without using any distillation from more powerful close-sourced models. Our work establishes the necessity of integrating world models into autonomous agent frameworks to unlock sustained adaptability. Code is available at https://github.com/Tencent/SelfEvolvingAgent 🧠 核心术语库 [[自演化智能体（Self-Evolving Agent）]] [[世界模型（World Model）]] [[共演化（Coevolution）]] [[想象引擎（Imagination Engine）]] [[前看模拟（Look-ahead Simulation）]] [[自指导数据（Self-Instructed Data）]] [[策略精炼（Policy Refinement）]] 🔬 核心方法简述 引入共演化世界模型（World Model LLM），利用预 训练语言模型对网页内容的先验知识，让世界模型承担双重角色：1）作为虚拟网页服务器，基于当前观察和动作预测下一观察，生成自指导训练数据来持续精炼智能体策略；2）作为推理时的想象引擎，执行前看模拟以指导动作选择。通过在真实网页环境（Mind2Web-Live、WebVoyager、GAIA-web）中的实验验证，相较现有自演化智能体提升10%性能，且未使用任何闭源强大模型的蒸馏。 💬 锐评 该工作提出将世界模型引入自演化框架以缓解性能停滞问题，思路有一定创新性，但10%的性能增益较为温和，且未清晰阐明世界模型与智能体策略之间的协同训练机制如何真正实现‘共演化’。此外，论文未讨论世界模型自身可能产生的误差累积问题，以及在复杂动态网页环境中预测准确性能否支撑可靠的前看模拟。当前仅在三个数据集上验证，缺乏更广泛的消融实验来验证各组件的独立贡献。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation.full_note: Gödel Agent: A Self-Referential Agent Framework for Recursive Self-Improvement 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Self_Evolution_Adaptation 👤 作者： Xunjian Yin, Xinyi Wang, Liangming Pan, Li Lin, Xiaojun Wan, William Yang Wang 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2024-10-06 10:49:40 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.04444v4 🧾 一句话总结： 提出受Gödel machine启发的自指代Agent框架，通过LLM动态修改自身逻辑实现递归自我改进，突破了现有Agent设计空间的局限。 📄 摘要： The rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs) has significantly enhanced the capabilities of AI-driven agents across various tasks. However, existing agentic systems, whether based on fixed pipeline algorithms or pre-defined meta-learning frameworks, cannot search the whole agent design space due to the restriction of human-designed components, and thus might miss the globally optimal agent design. In this paper, we introduce Gödel Agent, a self-evolving framework inspired by the Gödel machine, enabling agents to recursively improve themselves without relying on predefined routines or fixed optimization algorithms. Gödel Agent leverages LLMs to dynamically modify its own logic and behavior, guided solely by high-level objectives through prompting. Experimental results on mathematical reasoning and complex agent tasks demonstrate that implementation of Gödel Agent can achieve continuous self-improvement, surpassing manually crafted agents in performance, efficiency, and generalizability. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Gödel Agent]] [[Recursive Self-Improvement]] [[Self-Referential Agent]] [[Gödel machine]] [[Self-evolving framework]] 🔬 核心方法简述 受Gödel machine启发，利用LLM在高层目标的提示指导下，动态修改自身的逻辑和行为代码，实现无需预定义流程或固定优化算法的递归式自我改进。 💬 锐评 将Gödel machine引入LLM Agent极具想象力，打破了人工设计组件的限制。但其自我修改完全依赖LLM的反思能力，极易陷入局部最优、过拟合验证集或导致逻辑崩溃，理论完美但工程鲁棒性和可验证性存疑。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.title: Lifelong Robot Library Learning: Bootstrapping Composable and Generalizable Skills for Embodied Control with Language Models
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: 该文切中当前LLM具身控制领域'固定技能库+提示工程'的静态局限性痛点。其核心亮点在于放弃了主流的梯度微调路线，转而利用LLM的逻辑推理能力进行'技能抽象'，构建显式、可解释的技能库，巧妙规避了灾难性遗忘。然而，该方法对仿真环境保真度和LLM代码生成准确性的依赖极高，'自引导探索'生成的任务质量将直接决定技能库的有效性与收敛效率，存在语义漂移风险。
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: Lifelong Robot Library Learning: Bootstrapping Composable and Generalizable Skills for Embodied Control with Language Models 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Georgios Tziafas, Hamidreza Kasaei 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2024-06-26 20:25:30 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.18746v2 🧾 一句话总结： 突破LLM机器人控制静态库限制，构建记忆与技能抽象闭环，实现无需梯度优化的可组合、可泛化的终身技能学习。 📄 摘要： Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as a new paradigm for embodied reasoning and control, most recently by generating robot policy code that utilizes a custom library of vision and control primitive skills. However, prior arts fix their skills library and steer the LLM with carefully hand-crafted prompt engineering, limiting the agent to a stationary range of addressable tasks. In this work, we introduce LRLL, an LLM-based lifelong learning agent that continuously grows the robot skill library to tackle manipulation tasks of ever-growing complexity. LRLL achieves this with four novel contributions: 1) a soft memory module that allows dynamic storage and retrieval of past experiences to serve as context, 2) a self-guided exploration policy that proposes new tasks in simulation, 3) a skill abstractor that distills recent experiences into new library skills, and 4) a lifelong learning algorithm for enabling human users to bootstrap new skills with minimal online interaction. LRLL continuously transfers knowledge from the memory to the library, building composable, general and interpretable policies, while bypassing gradient-based optimization, thus relieving the learner from catastrophic forgetting. Empirical evaluation in a simulated tabletop environment shows that LRLL outperforms end-to-end and vanilla LLM approaches in the lifelong setup while learning skills that are transferable to the real world. Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: 该方法巧妙避开了端到端LLM翻译的不稳定性，引入GeoIR作为结构化桥梁，并通过“反例构造-诊断-修复”机制实现了形式化正确性的闭环验证。虽然宣称解决IMO难题，但在14个反例案例中仍依赖专家修正，说明其全自动闭环能力仍有边界；此外摘要提及IMO 2026题目颇为超前（或为特定未来数据集设定），体现了该工作在前沿探索上的激进姿态。
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: MechGeo: Autoformalizing and Proving Euclidean Geometry in Lean 4 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Hao Shen, Junyu Guo, Tian Cui, Yuxuan Xiao, Lihong Zhi 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-08-03 14:24:12 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02295v1 🧾 一句话总结： 通过引入GeoIR中间表示与反例引导修复机制，首次在Lean 4中实现了大规模IMO几何题的自动化形式化与认证证明，为可信几何推理建立了实用基线。 📄 摘要： We present MechGeo, a Mathlib native agentic framework that jointly addresses faithful autoformalization and certified proof construction for Euclidean geometry. In this framework, GeoFormalizer represents informal problems in GeoIR, deterministically translates them into Lean 4, and iteratively repairs candidate statements using structural diagnostics and semantic evaluation. GeoProver constructs geometric proof plans, derives intermediate lemmas, and selectively algebraizes suitable subgoals through a library verified in Lean. Singular or SymPy may generate algebraic certificates, but all resulting proofs and counterexamples are checked by Lean's kernel. Experiments across seven LLM backbones show substantial improvements in autoformalization, particularly for models with weaker direct translation performance. On 43 historical IMO geometry problems, GeoFormalizer generates formal statements that GeoProver proves in 29 cases; for the remaining 14, it constructs counterexamples verified in Lean and proves all repaired statements after expert correction. Together with IMO 2026 Problem 2, this yields, to the best of our knowledge, the largest reported collection of automated, kernel-checked Lean proofs for IMO geometry problems. On the 14 geometry statements in LEAP's Lean-IMO-Bench, MechGeo proves 12 for the first time, formally refutes the remaining two, and proves both repaired statements. These results establish counterexample guided diagnosis, geometric reasoning, and certified symbolic computation as a practical foundation for trustworthy formal geometry. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Autoformalization]] [[Lean 4]] [[GeoIR]] [[Counterexample-guided Diagnosis]] [[Certified Symbolic Computation]] 🔬 核心方法简述 构建了Mathlib原生的Agent框架：首先将非形式化问题转化为GeoIR中间表示并转译为Lean 4，利用反例引导的诊断循环进行迭代修复；随后GeoProver结合几何推理与认证的符号计算（Singular/SymPy），生成经Lean内核检验的严格证明。 💬 锐评 该方法巧妙避开了端到端LLM翻译的不稳定性，引入GeoIR作为结构化桥梁，并通过“反例构造-诊断-修复”机制实现了形式化正确性的闭环验证。虽然宣称解决IMO难题，但在14个反例案例中仍依赖专家修正，说明其全自动闭环能力仍有边界；此外摘要提及IMO 2026题目颇为超前（或为特定未来数据集设定），体现了该工作在前沿探索上的激进姿态。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.title: From Profiling to Synthesis: Benchmarking Implicit Behavioral Alignment in Personalized LLM Agents
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: 该研究精准定位了个性化代理的痛点——从静态配置到动态演进的鸿沟。通过引入噪声和隐式线索，不仅提升了基准的挑战性，更提出了针对性的IBA-Agent框架。这种数据特征驱动模型架构设计的思路，为冷启动阶段的个性化研究提供了极具深度的范式参考。
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: From Profiling to Synthesis: Benchmarking Implicit Behavioral Alignment in Personalized LLM Agents 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Jiajia Song, Bobo Li, Haiwen Yi, Zibo Ji, Meishan Zhang, Hao Fei, Min Zhang, Mong-Li Lee, Wynne Hsu 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-08-03 12:52:04 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02171v1 🧾 一句话总结： 构建了包含噪声与隐式线索的纵向交互基准IBA-Bench，并提出IBA-Agent框架以弥合个性化代理中的知识-行动鸿沟。 📄 摘要： Large Language Models have enabled increasingly capable autonomous agents, yet personalization remains critical for making such agents practically useful. Recent benchmarks have begun evaluating personalization in agents, but they largely rely on static preference snapshots, fixed interaction logs, or question answering over predefined user profiles. Such designs fail to capture the complexity of evolving user preferences and neglect preference-conditioned task execution-a discrepancy we term as the knowledge-to-action gap. To address this challenge, we introduce IBA-Bench, a benchmark for implicit behavioral alignment constructed from longitudinal interaction histories that contain noise, implicit cues, and temporal inconsistencies. Unlike prior work, IBA-Bench evaluates whether an agent can execute tasks while satisfying implicit user constraints inferred from historical interactions. We further propose IBA-Agent, an agent framework that reconciles conflicting priorities through broad retrieval and trajectory-level alignment. Experiment results on IBA-Bench show that effective personalization remains a significant challenge for state-of-the-art LLM agents, and the proposed IBA-Agent substantially improves behavioral alignment in complex scenarios across nine application domains. 🧠 核心术语库 [[IBA-Bench]] [[IBA-Agent]] [[知识-行动鸿沟]] [[隐性行为对齐]] [[纵向交互历史]] [[轨迹级对齐]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出IBA-Bench基准，利用包含噪声、隐式线索和时序不一致的纵向交互历史进行评估；提出IBA-Agent框架，通过广泛检索和轨迹级对齐来调和冲突的优先级，以填补知识到行动的鸿沟。 💬 锐评 该研究精准定位了个性化代理的痛点——从静态配置到动态演进的鸿沟。通过引入噪声和隐式线索，不仅提升了基准的挑战性，更提出了针对性的IBA-Agent框架。这种数据特征驱动模型架构设计的思路，为冷启动阶段的个性化研究提供了极具深度的范式参考。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.title: SkillAxe: Sharpening LLM-Authored Agent Skills Through Evaluation-Guided Self-Refinement
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: SkillAxe的创新性在于无需标注数据的自我改进机制，但维度划分的全面性和有效性可能受限于当前LLM能力，且未明确说明迭代次数和收敛条件。此外，技能库在真实场景中的泛化能力有待验证。
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: SkillAxe: Sharpening LLM-Authored Agent Skills Through Evaluation-Guided Self-Refinement 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Srishti Gautam, Arjun Radhakrishna, Sumit Gulwani 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-06-09 08:14:39 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.10546v2 🧾 一句话总结： SkillAxe通过无监督评估-改进循环显著提升LLM技能质量，缩短了与人类作者的差距，并在真实场景中实现性能飞跃。 📄 摘要： Skill documents, structured natural-language instructions that guide Large Language Model (LLM) agents, are critical to modern agent frameworks, yet LLMs struggle to write skills that actually work. On SkillsBench, human-authored skills improve pass rates by 16.2 percentage points, while LLM-authored skills provide no measurable gain. We introduce SkillAxe, a fully unsupervised framework that enables LLMs to iteratively diagnose and refine their own skills. SkillAxe decomposes skill quality into four interpretable dimensions (quality impact, trigger precision, instruction compliance with fault attribution, and solution-path coverage), producing structured improvement briefs that require no ground-truth labels, test suites, or environment rewards. On SkillsBench, SkillAxe improves pass rates by 28\% relative over unimproved LLM skills and closes 47--67\% of the gap to human-authored skills. We validate the approach as a continuous improvement engine in the wild on SpreadsheetBench, where a SkillAxe-built skill library learns from past agent trajectories and raises pass rate from 16.0\% to 52.0\% using only 22 skills. 🧠 核心术语库 [[SkillAxe]] [[技能质量维度]] [[自我评估]] [[迭代改进]] [[SkillsBench]] [[SpreadsheetBench]] 🔬 核心方法简述 SkillAxe采用无监督框架，通过自我评估和迭代改进提升LLM技能质量。具体步骤包括：1) 将技能质量分解为四个维度（质量影响、触发精度、指令合规性、解决方案覆盖率）；2) 生成无需标注的结构化改进简报；3) 通过迭代优化提升技能表现。 💬 锐评 SkillAxe的创新性在于无需标注数据的自我改进机制，但维度划分的全面性和有效性可能受限于当前LLM能力，且未明确说明迭代次数和收敛条件。此外，技能库在真实场景中的泛化能力有待验证。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.title: When Search Becomes Memory: Turning Robot Design Trials into Transferable Skills
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: 创新性地将LLM的生成能力与进化算法结合，但依赖大规模计算资源且技能库的泛化能力需进一步验证；未明确解决技能表述的歧义性问题，可能影响实际工程应用。
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: When Search Becomes Memory: Turning Robot Design Trials into Transferable Skills 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读/值得看 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Yunfei Wang, Xiaohao Xu, Yang Li, Xiaonan Huang 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-05-25 13:29:45 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.25832v1 🧾 一句话总结： 通过显式存储设计经验构建可迁移的技能库，显著提升机器人设计的冷启动效率与跨空间迁移性能。 📄 摘要： Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as proposal generators for evolutionary robot design, yet most loops remain memoryless: simulator results shape the next population but are not preserved as reusable design knowledge. We present Auto-Robotist, a self-evolving LLM agent that distills morphology-search traces into an explicit natural-language skill library. Each skill stores a structural archetype, evidence-grounded positive and negative rules, and the evaluated designs that support them, making design memory inspectable rather than implicit in a population. During search, the agent retrieves skills to condition LLM edits of elite bodies while retaining a Genetic Algorithm (GA) mutation path for exploration; after evaluation, it updates the library through Add, Diagnose, and Merge. Across seven EvoGym tasks spanning locomotion, traversal, and object interaction, Auto-Robotist improves cold-start 5x5 search and transfers learned skills to 10x10 design spaces, where reference-conditioned transfer outperforms GA on every task. These results suggest that LLM agents can convert expensive physical evaluations into reusable, auditable design principles. Our code will be released upon acceptance. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Auto-Robotist]] [[技能库（Skill Library）]] [[形态搜索（Morphology Search）]] [[遗传算法（GA）]] [[冷启动优化（Cold-start Optimization）]] [[跨任务迁移（Transfer Learning）]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出Auto-Robotist框架，通过LLM生成机器人设计提案并结合遗传算法优化，将搜索过程中的形态演化轨迹转化为可检索的自然语言技能库。技能库包含结构原型、证据驱动的规则及验证设计，通过Add/Diagnose/Merge机制动态更新，实现设计知识的显式存储与跨任务迁移。 💬 锐评 创新性地将LLM的生成能力与进化算法结合，但依赖大规模计算资源且技能库的泛化能力需进一步验证；未明确解决技能表述的歧义性问题，可能影响实际工程应用。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.title: SkillOps: Managing LLM Agent Skill Libraries as Self-Maintaining Software Ecosystems
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: 论文核心贡献在于提出技能库维护这一被忽视的问题，但存在几个局限：1)实验仅在ALFWorld单一环境评估，泛化性存疑；2)四维诊断指标的具体计算规则未充分展开；3)规则-based维护的覆盖度和适应性边界不清晰；4)与现有检索/规划agent的兼容性声称缺乏消融实验验证。
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: SkillOps: Managing LLM Agent Skill Libraries as Self-Maintaining Software Ecosystems 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Hongji Pu, Xinyuan Song, Liang Zhao 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-05-13 16:02:25 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13716v1 🧾 一句话总结： 首次系统化提出LLM agent技能库的技术债务问题及维护框架，通过技能契约建模和四维健康诊断实现低开销的库时维护，在ALFWorld上验证了有效性，为技能库运维提供了新思路。 📄 摘要： Large language model agents increasingly rely on skill libraries for multi-step tasks, yet these libraries can accumulate persistent defects as skills are added, reused, patched, and linked to changing dependencies. We call this failure mode skill technical debt: library-level defects that may not break a single skill locally but can harm future retrieval, composition, and execution. Existing skill-based agents mainly focus on task-time retrieval, planning, and repair, while library-time maintenance remains underexplored. We propose SkillOps, a method-agnostic plug-in framework for maintaining skill libraries. SkillOps represents each skill as a typed Skill Contract (P, O, A, V, F), organizes skills with a Hierarchical Skill Ecosystem Graph, and diagnoses library health across utility, compatibility, risk, and validation dimensions. Given a raw skill library, SkillOps produces a maintained library that can be used by existing retrieval or planning agents without changing their internal code. On ALFWorld, SkillOps achieves 79.5 percent task success as a standalone agent, outperforming the strongest baseline by 8.8 percentage points with no additional task-time large language model calls. As a plug-in layer, it improves retrieval-heavy baselines by 0.68 to 2.90 percentage points. The current rule-based maintenance implementation uses nearly zero library-time large language model calls or tokens, showing that skill-library maintenance can be added as a low-overhead architectural layer. 🧠 核心术语库 [[技能技术债务(Skill Technical Debt)]] [[技能契约(Skill Contract)]] [[层次技能生态系统图(Hierarchical Skill Ecosystem Graph)]] [[库健康诊断(Library Health Diagnosis)]] [[自维护软件生态系统(Self-Maintaining Software Ecosystem)]] 🔬 核心方法简述 SkillOps将每个技能建模为类型化技能契约(P参数 、O输出、A动作、V验证、F前置条件)，构建层次技能生态系统图组织技能库，从utility、compatibility、risk、validation四个维度诊断库健康状况。维护实现采用规则驱动，接近零库时LLM调用。 💬 锐评 论文核心贡献在于提出技能库维护这一被忽视的问题，但存在几个局限：1)实验仅在ALFWorld单一环境评估，泛化性存疑；2)四维诊断指标的具体计算规则未充分展开；3)规则-based维护的覆盖度和适应性边界不清晰；4)与现有检索/规划agent的兼容性声称缺乏消融实验验证。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.title: SkillX: Automatically Constructing Skill Knowledge Bases for Agents
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: 将经验显式表示为层次化技能库并跨模型复用的思路具有较高的工程落地价值，但“探索性技能扩展”若无严格的边界控制与验证机制，极易引入幻觉技能导致库污染。此外，高度依赖单一强模型(GLM-4.6)作为技能源，技能库的质量上限会被该模型的能力天花板锁死，且面对分布外(OOD)极端环境时的泛化可靠性仍需打问号。
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: SkillX: Automatically Constructing Skill Knowledge Bases for Agents 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Chenxi Wang, Zhuoyun Yu, Xin Xie, Wuguannan Yao, Runnan Fang, Shuofei Qiao, Kexin Cao, Guozhou Zheng, Xiang Qi, Peng Zhang, Shumin Deng 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-04-06 16:09:33 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.04804v2 🧾 一句话总结： SkillX提出了一种自动化构建三层架构即插即用技能库的框架，通过轨迹蒸馏、迭代优化与探索扩展实现了Agent经验的高效复用与弱模型赋能。 📄 摘要： Learning from experience is critical for building capable large language model (LLM) agents, yet prevailing self-evolving paradigms remain inefficient: agents learn in isolation, repeatedly rediscover similar behaviors from limited experience, resulting in redundant exploration and poor generalization. To address this problem, we propose SkillX, a fully automated framework for constructing a \textbf{plug-and-play skill knowledge base} that can be reused across agents and environments. SkillX operates through a fully automated pipeline built on three synergistic innovations: \textit{(i) Multi-Level Skills Design}, which distills raw trajectories into three-tiered hierarchy of strategic plans, functional skills, and atomic skills; \textit{(ii) Iterative Skills Refinement}, which automatically revises skills based on execution feedback to continuously improve library quality; and \textit{(iii) Exploratory Skills Expansion}, which proactively generates and validates novel skills to expand coverage beyond seed training data. Using a strong backbone agent (GLM-4.6), we automatically build a reusable skill library and evaluate its transferability on challenging long-horizon, user-interactive benchmarks, including AppWorld, BFCL-v3, and $τ^2$-Bench. Experiments show that SkillKB consistently improves task success and execution efficiency when plugged into weaker base agents, highlighting the importance of structured, hierarchical experience representations for generalizable agent learning. Our code will be publicly available soon at https://github.com/zjunlp/SkillX. 🧠 核心术语库 [[即插即用技能知识库]] [[多级技能设计]] [[迭代技能优化]] [[探索性技能扩展]] [[轨迹蒸馏]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出SkillX自动化框架构建即插即用技能知识库，包含三大核心机制：1) 多级技能设计：将原始轨迹蒸馏为战略计划、功能技能、原子技能三层架构；2) 迭代技能优化：基于执行反馈自动修订技能以提升质量；3) 探索性技能扩展：主动生成并验证新技能以扩充覆盖面。利用强模型(GLM-4.6)构建技能库，并即插即用地迁移至弱模型以提升其任务成功率和执行效率。 💬 锐评 将经验显式表示为层次化技能库并跨模型复用的思路具有较高的工程落地价值，但“探索性技能扩展”若无严格的边界控制与验证机制，极易引入幻觉技能导致库污染。此外，高度依赖单一强模型(GLM-4.6)作为技能源，技能库的质量上限会被该模型的能力天花板锁死，且面对分布外(OOD)极端环境时的泛化可靠性仍需打问号。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.title: EffiSkill: Agent Skill Based Automated Code Efficiency Optimization
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: 该工作直击现有LLM优化方法缺乏可复用知识、泛化能力弱的痛点，创新性地将隐式的代码优化经验显式化为'技能'，推动Agent从'一次性改写'向'知识沉淀与复用'进化；但'无执行'策略虽提升了效率，却也切断了运行时反馈的纠错路径，对模型静态诊断能力提出了极高要求。
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: EffiSkill: Agent Skill Based Automated Code Efficiency Optimization 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Zimu Wang, Yuling Shi, Mengfan Li, Zijun Liu, Jie M. Zhang, Chengcheng Wan, Xiaodong Gu 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-03-29 20:09:57 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.27850v1 🧾 一句话总结： 通过构建包含算子与元策略的显式技能库，成功实现了代码效率优化的知识蒸馏与泛化应用，为Agent技能学习提供了新的范式参考。 📄 摘要： Code efficiency is a fundamental aspect of software quality, yet how to harness large language models (LLMs) to optimize programs remains challenging. Prior approaches have sought for one-shot rewriting, retrieved exemplars, or prompt-based search, but they do not explicitly distill reusable optimization knowledge, which limits generalization beyond individual instances.   In this paper, we present EffiSkill, a framework for code-efficiency optimization that builds a portable optimization toolbox for LLM-based agents. The key idea is to model recurring slow-to-fast transformations as reusable agent skills that capture both concrete transformation mechanisms and higher-level optimization strategies. EffiSkill adopts a two-stage design: Stage I mines Operator and Meta Skills from large-scale slow/fast program pairs to build a skill library; Stage II applies this library to unseen programs through execution-free diagnosis, skill retrieval, plan composition, and candidate generation, without runtime feedback.   Results on EffiBench-X show that EffiSkill achieves higher optimization success rates, improving over the strongest baseline by 3.69 to 12.52 percentage points across model and language settings. These findings suggest that mechanism-level skill reuse provides a useful foundation for execution-free code optimization, and that the resulting skill library can serve as a reusable resource for broader agent workflows. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Agent Skill]] [[Skill Library]] [[Operator Skills]] [[Meta Skills]] [[Execution-free Optimization]] [[Knowledge Distillation]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出两阶段框架：第一阶段从大规模慢/快程序对中挖掘'算子技能'与'元技能'构建可复用技能库；第二阶段通过无执行诊断、检索与规划，将技能库应用于新程序的自动化优化。 💬 锐评 该工作直击现有LLM优化方法缺乏可复用知识、泛化能力弱的痛点，创新性地将隐式的代码优化经验显式化为'技能'，推动Agent从'一次性改写'向'知识沉淀与复用'进化；但'无执行'策略虽提升了效率，却也切断了运行时反馈的纠错路径，对模型静态诊断能力提出了极高要求。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.title: SkillRL: Evolving Agents via Recursive Skill-Augmented Reinforcement Learning
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: 该研究直击当前 LLM Agent 记忆模块“存多读慢、冗余且低效”的痛点，不再满足于存储 Raw Trajectory，而是通过蒸馏将其升维为 Hierarchical Skill。其最具洞察力的创新在于“递归进化”，它打破了传统静态技能库的僵化，让经验库随策略成长而迭代，这标志着 Agent 从单纯的“经验检索者”向“终身学习者”范式转变的关键一步。
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: SkillRL: Evolving Agents via Recursive Skill-Augmented Reinforcement Learning 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Peng Xia, Jianwen Chen, Hanyang Wang, Jiaqi Liu, Kaide Zeng, Yu Wang, Siwei Han, Yiyang Zhou, Xujiang Zhao, Haifeng Chen, Zeyu Zheng, Cihang Xie, Huaxiu Yao 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2026-02-09 03:17:17 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.08234v1 🧾 一句话总结： SkillRL 通过自动技能发现与递归进化机制，成功将冗余的原始经验转化为高效、可进化的行为技能库，大幅提升了 LLM Agent 在复杂任务中的推理效率与泛化能力。 📄 摘要： Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown stunning results in complex tasks, yet they often operate in isolation, failing to learn from past experiences. Existing memory-based methods primarily store raw trajectories, which are often redundant and noise-heavy. This prevents agents from extracting high-level, reusable behavioral patterns that are essential for generalization. In this paper, we propose SkillRL, a framework that bridges the gap between raw experience and policy improvement through automatic skill discovery and recursive evolution. Our approach introduces an experience-based distillation mechanism to build a hierarchical skill library SkillBank, an adaptive retrieval strategy for general and task-specific heuristics, and a recursive evolution mechanism that allows the skill library to co-evolve with the agent's policy during reinforcement learning. These innovations significantly reduce the token footprint while enhancing reasoning utility. Experimental results on ALFWorld, WebShop and seven search-augmented tasks demonstrate that SkillRL achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming strong baselines over 15.3% and maintaining robustness as task complexity increases. Code is available at this https://github.com/aiming-lab/SkillRL. 🧠 核心术语库 [[SkillRL]] [[SkillBank]] [[Experience-based Distillation]] [[Recursive Evolution]] [[Adaptive Retrieval]] 🔬 核心方法简述 提出 SkillRL 框架，旨在解决原始轨迹冗余和噪声问题。核心包含三个部分：一是基于经验的蒸馏机制，将原始轨迹转化为分层的技能库；二是自适应检索策略，用于匹配通用和任务特定的启发式规则；三是递归进化机制，使技能库与 Agent 策略在强化学习过程中协同进化，从而实现从原始经验到策略提升的闭环。 💬 锐评 该研究直击当前 LLM Agent 记忆模块“存多读慢、冗余且低效”的痛点，不再满足于存储 Raw Trajectory，而是通过蒸馏将其升维为 Hierarchical Skill。其最具洞察力的创新在于“递归进化”，它打破了传统静态技能库的僵化，让经验库随策略成长而迭代，这标志着 Agent 从单纯的“经验检索者”向“终身学习者”范式转变的关键一步。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.title: Reinforcement Learning for Self-Improving Agent with Skill Library
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: 该工作极具启发性，通过RL机制解决了技能库‘冷启动’和‘一致性’的痛点。顺序执行机制模拟了人类技能习得的递进过程，而技能集成奖励的设计确保了技能不仅可用，而且高效。对于希望Agent具备持续进化能力的团队，这是必读的范式参考。
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: Reinforcement Learning for Self-Improving Agent with Skill Library 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Jiongxiao Wang, Qiaojing Yan, Yawei Wang, Yijun Tian, Soumya Smruti Mishra, Zhichao Xu, Megha Gandhi, Panpan Xu, Lin Lee Cheong 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2025-12-18 21:58:19 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.17102v2 🧾 一句话总结： SAGE通过RL驱动的顺序执行和技能集成奖励，赋能Agent实现自我进化与技能复用，在AppWorld上实现了准确率提升、交互步数减少和Token消耗降低的三重优化。 📄 摘要： Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in complex reasoning and multi-turn interactions but struggle to continuously improve and adapt when deployed in new environments. One promising approach is implementing skill libraries that allow agents to learn, validate, and apply new skills. However, current skill library approaches rely primarily on LLM prompting, making consistent skill library implementation challenging. To overcome these challenges, we propose a Reinforcement Learning (RL)-based approach to enhance agents' self-improvement capabilities with a skill library. Specifically, we introduce Skill Augmented GRPO for self-Evolution (SAGE), a novel RL framework that systematically incorporates skills into learning. The framework's key component, Sequential Rollout, iteratively deploys agents across a chain of similar tasks for each rollout. As agents navigate through the task chain, skills generated from previous tasks accumulate in the library and become available for subsequent tasks. Additionally, the framework enhances skill generation and utilization through a Skill-integrated Reward that complements the original outcome-based rewards. Experimental results on AppWorld demonstrate that SAGE, when applied to supervised-finetuned model with expert experience, achieves 8.9% higher Scenario Goal Completion while requiring 26% fewer interaction steps and generating 59% fewer tokens, substantially outperforming existing approaches in both accuracy and efficiency. 🧠 核心术语库 [[SAGE (Skill Augmented GRPO for self-Evolution)]] [[Sequential Rollout (顺序执行)]] [[Skill-integrated Reward (技能集成奖励)]] [[Skill Library (技能库)]] 🔬 核心方法简述 SAGE框架利用‘顺序执行’在相似任务链上迭代rollout，结合‘技能集成奖励’来优化技能生成与利用，从而实现技能库的动态积累与复用。 💬 锐评 该工作极具启发性，通过RL机制解决了技能库‘冷启动’和‘一致性’的痛点。顺序执行机制模拟了人类技能习得的递进过程，而技能集成奖励的设计确保了技能不仅可用，而且高效。对于希望Agent具备持续进化能力的团队，这是必读的范式参考。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.title: Odyssey: Empowering Minecraft Agents with Open-World Skills
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: 批判性锐评：虽然Odyssey在技能库和基准测试方面有所创新，但其对开放世界探索的局限性仍需进一步验证。例如，技能库是否足够覆盖所有游戏可能性？长期规划能力是否真正有效？此外，依赖维基数据集可能导致智能体缺乏对非结构化信息的处理能力。
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: Odyssey: Empowering Minecraft Agents with Open-World Skills 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Shunyu Liu, Yaoru Li, Kongcheng Zhang, Zhenyu Cui, Wenkai Fang, Yuxuan Zheng, Tongya Zheng, Mingli Song 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2024-07-22 02:06:59 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.15325v3 🧾 一句话总结： 一句话价值总结：Odyssey通过构建技能库和微调LLM，提升了Minecraft中智能体的开放世界能力，但其在长期规划和泛化能力上仍面临挑战。 📄 摘要： Recent studies have delved into constructing generalist agents for open-world environments like Minecraft. Despite the encouraging results, existing efforts mainly focus on solving basic programmatic tasks, e.g., material collection and tool-crafting following the Minecraft tech-tree, treating the ObtainDiamond task as the ultimate goal. This limitation stems from the narrowly defined set of actions available to agents, requiring them to learn effective long-horizon strategies from scratch. Consequently, discovering diverse gameplay opportunities in the open world becomes challenging. In this work, we introduce Odyssey, a new framework that empowers Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents with open-world skills to explore the vast Minecraft world. Odyssey comprises three key parts: (1) An interactive agent with an open-world skill library that consists of 40 primitive skills and 183 compositional skills. (2) A fine-tuned LLaMA-3 model trained on a large question-answering dataset with 390k+ instruction entries derived from the Minecraft Wiki. (3) A new agent capability benchmark includes the long-term planning task, the dynamic-immediate planning task, and the autonomous exploration task. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed Odyssey framework can effectively evaluate different capabilities of LLM-based agents. All datasets, model weights, and code are publicly available to motivate future research on more advanced autonomous agent solutions. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Open-World Skills]] [[LLM-based Agents]] [[Skill Library]] [[Fine-tuned LLaMA-3]] [[Agent Capability Benchmark]] 🔬 核心方法简述 核心方法简述：Odyssey框架包含三个关键部分：1) 具有开放世界技能库的交互式智能体（包含40个原始技能和183个组合技能）；2) 基于Minecraft维基数据集微调的LLaMA-3模型；3) 包含长期规划、动态即时规划和自主探索的新智能体能力基准。 💬 锐评 批判性锐评：虽然Odyssey在技能库和基准测试方面有所创新，但其对开放世界探索的局限性仍需进一步验证。例如，技能库是否足够覆盖所有游戏可能性？长期规划能力是否真正有效？此外，依赖维基数据集可能导致智能体缺乏对非结构化信息的处理能力。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.title: Agentic Skill Discovery
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: 依赖LLM生成的任务提案可能存在语义偏差，强化学习的探索效率需进一步优化，且验证模型的泛化能力有待验证
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: Agentic Skill Discovery 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 必读 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Xufeng Zhao, Cornelius Weber, Stefan Wermter 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2024-05-23 19:44:03 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.15019v2 🧾 一句话总结： 该研究开创性地通过LLM驱动的自主学习框架，实现了机器人技能库的零样本自组织演化 📄 摘要： Language-conditioned robotic skills make it possible to apply the high-level reasoning of Large Language Models (LLMs) to low-level robotic control. A remaining challenge is to acquire a diverse set of fundamental skills. Existing approaches either manually decompose a complex task into atomic robotic actions in a top-down fashion, or bootstrap as many combinations as possible in a bottom-up fashion to cover a wider range of task possibilities. These decompositions or combinations, however, require an initial skill library. For example, a ``grasping'' capability can never emerge from a skill library containing only diverse ``pushing'' skills. Existing skill discovery techniques with reinforcement learning acquire skills by an exhaustive exploration but often yield non-meaningful behaviors. In this study, we introduce a novel framework for skill discovery that is entirely driven by LLMs. The framework begins with an LLM generating task proposals based on the provided scene description and the robot's configurations, aiming to incrementally acquire new skills upon task completion. For each proposed task, a series of reinforcement learning processes are initiated, utilizing reward and success determination functions sampled by the LLM to develop the corresponding policy. The reliability and trustworthiness of learned behaviors are further ensured by an independent vision-language model. We show that starting with zero skill, the skill library emerges and expands to more and more meaningful and reliable skills, enabling the robot to efficiently further propose and complete advanced tasks. Project page: \url{https://agentic-skill-discovery.github.io}. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Language-conditioned robotic skills]] [[LLM-driven skill discovery]] [[Reinforcement Learning with LLM-sampled rewards]] [[Vision-Language Model for Validation]] [[Skill Library Evolution]] 🔬 核心方法简述 基于LLM生成任务提案，通过强化学习开发对应策略，结合独立视觉-语言模型验证可靠性，实现从零开始构建渐进式技能库 💬 锐评 依赖LLM生成的任务提案可能存在语义偏差，强化学习的探索效率需进一步优化，且验证模型的泛化能力有待验证 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。

Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.title: Bootstrap Your Own Skills: Learning to Solve New Tasks with Large Language Model Guidance
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.short_review: 该工作将LLM作为技能规划的引导者有一定新意，但核心问题仍显模糊：LLM如何判断"有意义技能"的具体依据？实验仅在模拟家庭环境评估，未见真实机器人实验；所谓"无监督"其实依赖LLM的隐式监督，实质是将人工设计prompt的工作转嫁给了LLG；与naive bootstrapping对比的提升幅度和鲁棒性存疑。
Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill.full_note: Bootstrap Your Own Skills: Learning to Solve New Tasks with Large Language Model Guidance 🆕 入库阶段： 首次运行（冷启动） 🔥 推荐指数： 值得看 📂 分类： Agent_Memory_Experience_Skill 👤 作者： Jesse Zhang, Jiahui Zhang, Karl Pertsch, Ziyi Liu, Xiang Ren, Minsuk Chang, Shao-Hua Sun, Joseph J. Lim 🕒 arXiv上传时间： 2023-10-16 02:43:47 UTC 🔗 原文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.10021v2 🧾 一句话总结： 提出利用LLM指导强化学习agent进行技能自举以零样本完成新长视野任务的新思路，是LLM+RL结合的有益探索，但离实际部署仍有距离。 📄 摘要： We propose BOSS, an approach that automatically learns to solve new long-horizon, complex, and meaningful tasks by growing a learned skill library with minimal supervision. Prior work in reinforcement learning require expert supervision, in the form of demonstrations or rich reward functions, to learn long-horizon tasks. Instead, our approach BOSS (BOotStrapping your own Skills) learns to accomplish new tasks by performing "skill bootstrapping," where an agent with a set of primitive skills interacts with the environment to practice new skills without receiving reward feedback for tasks outside of the initial skill set. This bootstrapping phase is guided by large language models (LLMs) that inform the agent of meaningful skills to chain together. Through this process, BOSS builds a wide range of complex and useful behaviors from a basic set of primitive skills. We demonstrate through experiments in realistic household environments that agents trained with our LLM-guided bootstrapping procedure outperform those trained with naive bootstrapping as well as prior unsupervised skill acquisition methods on zero-shot execution of unseen, long-horizon tasks in new environments. Website at clvrai.com/boss. 🧠 核心术语库 [[Skill bootstrapping（技能自举）]] [[Zero-shot execution（零样本执行）]] [[Long-horizon tasks（长视野任务）]] [[Unsupervised skill acquisition（无监督技能获取）]] [[Primitive skills（原始技能）]] [[LLM-guided skill chaining（LLM引导的技能链）]] 🔬 核心方法简述 BOSS方法通过"技能自举"机制学习新任务：给定一组原始技能，agent在 无外部奖励反馈的环境中自主探索实践新技能；LLM在 bootstrapping 阶段提供指导，告知agent哪些技能值得链接组合以完成有意义的长视野任务，从而从原始技能构建出复杂行为库。 💬 锐评 该工作将LLM作为技能规划的引导者有一定新意，但核心问题仍显模糊：LLM如何判断"有意义技能"的具体依据？实验仅在模拟家庭环境评估，未见真实机器人实验；所谓"无监督"其实依赖LLM的隐式监督，实质是将人工设计prompt的工作转嫁给了LLG；与naive bootstrapping对比的提升幅度和鲁棒性存疑。 📝 说明： 该条目在冷启动阶段按关键词检索后完成单篇深读分析，后续增量任务将继续进行相关性对比与深度比较。
